qs.q: Which town or city do you live in now?
qs.vi: Bạn hiện sống ở thị trấn/thành phố nào?
qs.a6: I live in Ho Chi Minh City, which is the biggest city in southern Vietnam. I've lived here for about ten years, since I started working. It's a busy place, but I really like the energy here.
qs.a7: I'm currently based in Ho Chi Minh City, the economic hub of Vietnam. I moved here about ten years ago for work, and I've grown quite attached to the place. It can be hectic at times, but there's always something going on.

vocab.u: *Hanoi is a political and cultural hub.*

qs.grammar: *Present perfect + for/since* → "I've lived here **for** ten years / **since** 2015." Áp dụng: *I've worked here for 3 years. I've studied English since last year.*

qs.q: Are there any things you don't like about your area? (What are they?)
qs.vi: Có điều gì bạn không thích ở khu vực của mình không?
qs.a6: Yes, there are a few things. The biggest problem is the traffic, especially at rush hour. The air is also quite polluted, so sometimes it's hard to breathe.
qs.a7: Well, the main thing that gets on my nerves is the traffic. During rush hour the streets are jam-packed, and it can take me nearly an hour to get home. On top of that, the air pollution is pretty bad, which isn't great for my health.

vocab.u: *The roads are crowded at rush hour.*

vocab.e: Không dùng cho người lạ trong tình huống trang trọng

vocab.u: *The metro is jam-packed in the morning.*

vocab.e: Đừng lạm dụng, 1 lần/câu trả lời là đủ

qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định* → ", **which** isn't great for my health." (which = cả ý ở trước). Áp dụng: *I wake up at 5, which is really early.*

qs.q: Do you think you will continue to live there for a long time? (Why? Why not?)
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ mình sẽ sống ở đó lâu dài không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. My job and my family are here, so it's convenient for me. But maybe in the future I'll move to a quieter place when I get older.
qs.a7: I'd say so, at least for the foreseeable future. My job is here and so are most of my friends, so moving would be quite a hassle. That said, I might consider settling down somewhere quieter once I retire.

vocab.m: trong tương lai gần/có thể thấy trước
vocab.u: *I'll stay here for the foreseeable future.*
Đứng đầu câu, có dấu phẩy
*I want to settle down in the countryside.*

vocab.e: Sau "once" dùng **hiện tại đơn** cho tương lai

qs.grammar: *"so" + đảo trợ động từ để nói "cũng vậy"* → "My job is here **and so are** most of my friends." Áp dụng: *I like coffee, and so does my sister.* (Dùng được khi cần thêm một ý đơn giản, tự nhiên.)

qs.q: What are some changes in the area recently?
qs.vi: Gần đây khu vực của bạn có thay đổi gì?
qs.a6: Yes, there have been many changes. They built a new metro line, and some new shopping malls opened near my house. Now it's more convenient to go around.
qs.a7: Quite a few, actually. The most noticeable one is the new metro line, which has made getting around a lot easier. A number of shopping centres and cafés have also sprung up in my neighbourhood, so the area feels much livelier than before.

vocab.e: "quite a few" đi với danh từ đếm được

vocab.u: *It's easy to get around by bus.*

qs.grammar: *Present perfect nói về thay đổi gần đây* → "There **have been** changes." / "It **has made** getting around easier." Và cấu trúc **make + object + adj/easier**. Áp dụng: *Online shopping has made life more convenient.*

qs.q: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
qs.vi: Bạn sống ở nhà riêng hay chung cư?
qs.a6: I live in an apartment on the ninth floor. It's not very big, but it's enough for me, and it's quite safe.
qs.a7: I live in an apartment on the ninth floor of a high-rise building. It's fairly compact, but it's cosy and has everything I need, and the security is pretty good too.

vocab.u: Dùng giới từ **on** + số thứ tự
*a high-rise building in the city centre*

vocab.m: có đủ mọi thứ tôi cần
vocab.u: Cụm tự nhiên khi nói về nhà

qs.grammar: *"not very big, **but**..." (nhượng bộ đơn giản)* → "It's small, **but** it's comfortable." Áp dụng cho mọi chủ đề: *The salary isn't high, but I like my job.*

qs.q: What is your favourite room in your home? (Why?)
qs.vi: Phòng yêu thích trong nhà là phòng nào? Tại sao?
qs.a6: My favourite room is the living room because it's very comfortable. I often watch TV and relax there after work. It also has a big window, so it's bright.
qs.a7: Without a doubt, it's the living room. It's where I unwind after a long day at work, usually by watching Netflix on the sofa. There's also a large window, so it gets plenty of natural light, which makes it feel really welcoming.

vocab.m: chắc chắn, không nghi ngờ gì

vocab.u: *The room gets lots of natural light.*
vocab.e: "get plenty of light" tự nhiên hơn "have"

vocab.m: tạo cảm giác dễ chịu, đón chào

qs.grammar: *"by + V-ing"* (bằng cách) → "I unwind **by watching** Netflix." Áp dụng: *I save money by cooking at home.*

qs.q: What things make your home pleasant to live in? (Why?)
qs.vi: Điều gì làm ngôi nhà của bạn dễ chịu để sống?
qs.a6: I think it's the quiet and the cleanliness. I always keep my home tidy, and I have some plants. Also, my family is there, so I feel very comfortable.
qs.a7: For me, it's a combination of things. I like to keep the place spotless and I have a few indoor plants, which give it a fresh, relaxing atmosphere. But what really makes it feel like home is having my family around.
qs.grammar: *Câu nhấn mạnh với "what"* → "**What** really makes it feel like home **is** my family." Áp dụng: *What I like most about my job is the people.* (Đừng dùng quá 1 lần/bài.)

qs.q: Are the people in your neighbourhood nice and friendly?
qs.vi: Những người trong khu phố của bạn có tốt bụng, thân thiện không?
qs.a6: Yes, most of them are friendly. They often say hello to me in the elevator. When I need help, they are willing to help.
qs.a7: By and large, yes. They're pretty easygoing and always greet me when we bump into each other in the lift. They're also quite helpful. Once a neighbour even picked up a parcel for me while I was away.

vocab.u: *By and large, people here are kind.*
*She always greets me with a smile.*
vocab.e: "greet" **không** cần "to": greet me, không "greet to me"

vocab.u: *Could you pick up a parcel for me?*

qs.grammar: *Dùng "Once" / "when" kể ví dụ ngắn* → "**Once** a neighbour even picked up a parcel for me." Mẫu "Once + quá khứ" giúp thêm ví dụ cụ thể cho bất kỳ câu trả lời nào.

qs.q: Do you know any of your neighbours?
qs.vi: Bạn có quen hàng xóm nào không?
qs.a6: I know a few of them. My next-door neighbour is an old woman, and sometimes we chat for a while. But I don't know the others because I'm busy with work.
qs.a7: Only a handful, to be honest. I'm on good terms with my next-door neighbour, an elderly lady, and we occasionally have a chat in the corridor. As for the rest, I barely know them because I'm out most of the day.

vocab.u: *I'm on good terms with my colleagues.*

vocab.m: Còn những người còn lại thì...

vocab.e: Đã mang nghĩa phủ định, **không** thêm "not"

qs.grammar: *Trạng từ tần suất* → "we **occasionally** have a chat". Áp dụng: *I rarely cook. I sometimes eat out. I usually take the bus.* (Đặt trước động từ thường, sau "be".)

qs.q: Do you know any famous people in your area?
qs.vi: Bạn có biết người nổi tiếng nào ở khu vực của mình không?
qs.a6: No, I don't. As far as I know, there are no famous people in my area. It's just a normal residential area.
qs.a7: Not that I know of. It's a fairly ordinary residential area, so I've never run into anyone famous. Although, who knows, maybe some celebrities live nearby and I just haven't noticed!

vocab.u: Trả lời phủ định lịch sự
*As far as I know, he's moved abroad.*

qs.grammar: *Present perfect với "never"* → "I've **never** run into anyone famous." Áp dụng: *I've never been to Japan. I've never tried skydiving.*

qs.q: Do you work or are you a student?
qs.vi: Bạn đi làm hay đi học?
qs.a6: I'm working. I have a full-time job in an office.
qs.a7: I work full-time. I've been in my current job for a few years now.

vocab.m: toàn thời gian / bán thời gian
vocab.e: Đừng nói "I am work" – dùng "I work" hoặc "I'm working"

qs.q: What kind of work do you do?
qs.vi: Bạn làm công việc gì?
qs.a6: I work as an administrative officer at a small company. I handle documents, answer emails and schedule meetings for my team. It's a desk job, but it keeps me busy all day.
qs.a7: I work as an administrative assistant at a mid-sized company. My job involves handling paperwork, replying to emails and arranging meetings for my team. It's mostly desk-based, but it keeps me on my toes.

vocab.u: *I handle paperwork for the HR team.*

vocab.m: khiến ai luôn phải tỉnh táo, bận rộn
vocab.u: *My boss keeps me on my toes.*
vocab.e: Thành ngữ, dùng 1 lần là đủ

qs.grammar: *"My job involves + V-ing"* → "My job involves **handling** paperwork." Áp dụng: *My studies involve reading a lot of articles.*

qs.q: What do you find most interesting about your work? (Why?)
qs.vi: Điều thú vị nhất trong công việc của bạn là gì? Tại sao?
qs.a6: I think it's working with different people. Every day I talk to colleagues from many departments, so I learn a lot. It's never boring.
qs.a7: What I find most interesting is the variety. I deal with people from different departments every day, so no two days are the same. I also pick up new skills along the way, which I really enjoy.

vocab.u: *I like the variety in my job.*
vocab.e: Danh từ không đếm được, "the variety"

vocab.p: no two days are the same
vocab.m: không có hai ngày nào giống nhau
trên đường đi, trong quá trình

qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề "What" làm chủ ngữ* → "**What I find most interesting is** the variety." Áp dụng: *What I like about my hometown is the food.*

qs.q: Which is more important to you – the people you work with or the work you do? (Why?)
qs.vi: Quan trọng hơn: đồng nghiệp hay công việc? Tại sao?
qs.a6: For me, the people I work with are more important. If my colleagues are friendly, I feel happy and work better. Even a boring job is fine with good people.
qs.a7: Honestly, I'd say the people. A supportive team makes even a tedious task bearable, whereas a great job with difficult colleagues would drain me. So I'd pick good company over an exciting role any day.

vocab.u: *I like tea, whereas my wife likes coffee.*

qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 2 (giả định)* → "a great job with difficult colleagues **would drain** me." Áp dụng: *If I had more time, I would learn the guitar.*

qs.q: Do you work best in the morning or the afternoon? (Why?)
qs.vi: Bạn làm việc hiệu quả nhất vào buổi sáng hay buổi chiều?
qs.a6: I work best in the morning. My head is clear and there are fewer interruptions. In the afternoon I often feel sleepy after lunch.
qs.a7: Definitely the morning. My mind is sharp and the office is quieter, so I can get through the tough tasks first. After lunch I tend to hit a slump, so I save the easy stuff for then.

vocab.u: *I tend to feel tired after lunch.*
vocab.e: Sau "tend to" dùng **động từ nguyên mẫu**

vocab.m: rơi vào trạng thái uể oải

vocab.u: *I save easy tasks for the afternoon.*

qs.grammar: *Giới từ thời gian* → "**in** the morning / **in** the afternoon / **at** night / **at** the weekend". Lỗi hay gặp: "in the night", "on the weekend" (Anh–Anh dùng *at the weekend*).

qs.q: What do you study?
qs.vi: Bạn học ngành gì?
qs.a6: I study Business Administration at a university in Ho Chi Minh City. I'm in my third year. I take classes in the evening because I also work.
qs.a7: I'm majoring in Business Administration at a university here. I'm in my third year, and since I work during the day, I attend evening classes.

vocab.e: Đừng nói "year three" kiểu Việt hóa

qs.grammar: *"since" nêu lý do* → "**Since** I work during the day, I attend evening classes." Áp dụng: *Since it was raining, I stayed home.*

qs.q: What do you find most interesting about your studies? (Why?)
qs.a6: I like learning about management and marketing because I can use it in real life. The lessons are practical, not just theory.
qs.a7: What fascinates me most is how practical it is. We study real case studies from companies, which I can relate to my own job. It's much more engaging than just memorising theory.
qs.grammar: *So sánh hơn có "much"* → "It's **much more engaging than** theory." Áp dụng: *Public transport is much cheaper than driving.*

qs.q: Which is more important to you – the teachers or the other students on your course? (Why?)
qs.a6: The teachers are more important to me. A good teacher explains clearly and helps me understand. But classmates are also useful because we share notes.
qs.a7: I'd go for the teachers. A good lecturer can make a difficult subject click, and that's what I'm really there for. That said, classmates matter too, since we swap notes and motivate each other.
qs.grammar: *Dùng "That said" để cân bằng quan điểm* (giống phần I-1), rất hợp với câu hỏi so sánh "A hay B".

qs.q: How much time do you spend studying every week?
qs.a6: About ten hours a week. I have class three evenings, and I study for two hours at the weekend.
qs.a7: Roughly ten hours a week. I'm in class three evenings a week, and I put in a couple of hours at the weekend to catch up on reading.
qs.grammar: *Số lượng + a + đơn vị thời gian* → "ten hours **a week**". Áp dụng: *I exercise three times a week.*

qs.q: How do you usually travel to the city where you study?
qs.a6: I take the bus to school. It takes about thirty minutes. Sometimes I go by motorbike if I'm late.
qs.a7: I usually hop on a bus, which takes about half an hour. If I'm running late, I'll go by motorbike instead, although parking there is a nightmare.
qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 1* → "**If** I'm running late, I'**ll** go by motorbike." Áp dụng: *If it rains, I'll stay home.*

qs.q: Do you study best in the morning or the afternoon? (Why?)
qs.a6: I study best in the morning, especially at the weekend. I feel fresh and I can focus. In the afternoon I often feel tired.
qs.a7: Probably the morning, especially at weekends. My head is clear, so I can concentrate for longer without getting distracted. By the afternoon I start to lose focus.
qs.grammar: *"without + V-ing"* → "without **getting** distracted". Áp dụng: *He left without saying goodbye.*

qs.q: Have you always wanted to study this subject / these subjects? (Why? Why not?)
qs.a6: Not really. When I was young, I wanted to be a doctor. But later I became interested in business, so I changed my mind.
qs.a7: Not exactly. As a kid I dreamt of becoming a doctor, but I changed my mind in high school once I realised business suited me better. Looking back, I think it was the right call.

vocab.e: Không phải "change my opinion" khi nói về quyết định

qs.grammar: *Quá khứ đơn kể thay đổi + "once"* → "I changed my mind **once I realised**..." Áp dụng: *I felt better once I started exercising.*

topics.title: Computers / Tablets

qs.q: In what conditions would you use a computer?
qs.vi: Bạn dùng máy tính trong những hoàn cảnh nào?
qs.a6: I use a computer mainly at work. As a software tester, I need it to run test cases and write bug reports. At home, I also use my laptop to watch videos or study English.
qs.a7: Mostly for work. As a software tester, I spend most of the day running test cases and logging bugs. Outside work, I'll turn to my laptop whenever I need to study or watch something on a bigger screen.

vocab.u: *I run test cases every day.* Dùng "run", không phải "do"

vocab.m: ghi nhận / báo lỗi phần mềm

vocab.u: *I turn to my laptop when I need to study.* Đi với **to**

qs.grammar: *spend + thời gian + V-ing* → "I spend most of the day **running** test cases." (không nói "spend … to run")

qs.q: When was the first time you used a computer?
qs.vi: Lần đầu bạn dùng máy tính là khi nào?
qs.a6: I think it was in secondary school, when I was about twelve. We had a computer class once a week. We only learned to type and draw a little, so it was quite basic.
qs.a7: If I remember correctly, it was around the age of twelve, in a computer lab at school. We only learned the basics, like typing and using Paint, but I was really excited because I'd never touched a computer before.

vocab.u: Mở câu khi không chắc chắn, rất tự nhiên

qs.grammar: *Quá khứ hoàn thành* để nói việc xảy ra trước một mốc quá khứ: "I **had never touched** a computer before." (rút gọn: *I'd never touched*)

qs.q: In what conditions would it be difficult for you to use a computer?
qs.vi: Trong hoàn cảnh nào bạn khó dùng máy tính?
qs.a6: It's difficult when there's no electricity or no internet. It's also hard to use a computer on the bus because it's crowded and the bus shakes a lot.
qs.a7: Mainly when the power goes out or the Wi-Fi is down, since I rely on the internet for almost everything. It's also a pain to use a laptop on the bus, because it's packed and the ride is bumpy.

vocab.u: *It's a pain to commute at rush hour.*

qs.grammar: *since + lý do* → "...since I rely on the internet." Áp dụng: *Since I take the bus, I can't use a laptop.*

topics.note: Thông tin giả định dùng trong bài mẫu (theo hồ sơ của bạn): IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, sống ngoại thành, đi xe buýt đi làm, ít sở thích, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Chi tiết nhỏ (Đà Nẵng, Nhật Bản...) là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật khi trả lời lại để mình chấm.

topics.title: Collecting Things

qs.q: Do you collect things?
qs.vi: Bạn có sưu tầm thứ gì không?
qs.a6: No, I don't really. I'm not a collector, and I don't have many hobbies. But I keep some old books and a few souvenirs from trips.
qs.a7: Not really, to be honest. I'm not much of a collector, but I do hold on to a few souvenirs from the places I've visited, like fridge magnets.

vocab.u: *I hold on to old photos.* Đi với **on to**

qs.grammar: *do + V nhấn mạnh* → "I **do** hold on to a few souvenirs." Dùng sau câu phủ định để "nhưng thực ra có".

qs.q: Are there any things you keep from childhood?
qs.vi: Bạn có giữ lại thứ gì từ thời thơ ấu không?
qs.a6: Yes, I still keep some of my old school notebooks and a few toys. They remind me of my childhood, so I don't want to throw them away.
qs.a7: Yes, a few things. I've still got some old notebooks and toy cars in a box at my parents' house. They bring back good memories, so I could never bring myself to throw them away.

vocab.u: *It reminds me of my school days.* Đi với **of**
*I can't bring myself to sell it.*

qs.grammar: *so + kết quả* → "They bring back good memories, **so** I could never throw them away."

qs.q: Where do you usually keep things you need?
qs.vi: Bạn thường để những thứ cần dùng ở đâu?
qs.a6: I usually keep them in my desk drawer at home. Important documents are in a folder, and small things like keys are near the door.
qs.a7: I'm quite organised about it. Documents go in a folder in my desk drawer, and everyday items like my keys and wallet stay in a tray by the front door, so I can grab them on my way out.
qs.grammar: *so I can + V* (mục đích) → "...so I can grab them quickly."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định dùng trong bài mẫu (theo hồ sơ của bạn): IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, sống ngoại thành, đi xe buýt đi làm, ít sở thích, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Chi tiết nhỏ (Đà Nẵng, Nhật Bản...) là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật khi trả lời lại để mình chấm.

topics.title: Street Market

qs.q: Are street markets common in your country?
qs.vi: Chợ đường phố có phổ biến ở nước bạn không?
qs.a6: Yes, very common. In Vietnam, you can find them in almost every area, especially in the morning. People go there to buy fresh food.
qs.a7: Absolutely. They're everywhere in Vietnam, from the countryside to the heart of Hanoi. Many people still do their daily shopping there, especially in the early morning.
qs.grammar: *still + V* (vẫn) → "Many people **still do** their shopping there."

qs.q: What is usually sold there?
qs.vi: Ở đó thường bán gì?
qs.a6: Mostly fresh food like vegetables, fruit, meat and fish. Some markets also sell clothes and cheap things for the home.
qs.a7: Mainly fresh produce, such as vegetables, fruit, meat and seafood. Some stalls also sell clothes and household items at very low prices.
qs.grammar: *such as + ví dụ* → "fresh produce, **such as** vegetables and fruit." (không dùng "such as" rồi lại "etc.")

qs.q: Do you think people like street markets? Why?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ mọi người thích chợ đường phố không? Tại sao?
qs.a6: Yes, I think many people do, especially older people. The food is fresh and cheap, and they can talk to the sellers. But young people prefer supermarkets because they're cleaner.
qs.a7: I'd say so, particularly the older generation. The produce is fresh and reasonably priced, and they can haggle with the sellers. Younger people, on the other hand, tend to prefer supermarkets since they're cleaner and more convenient.
qs.grammar: *so sánh hai nhóm* → "Older people like..., **while** younger people prefer..." (dùng *while / whereas* để đối lập).

topics.note: Thông tin giả định dùng trong bài mẫu (theo hồ sơ của bạn): IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, sống ngoại thành, đi xe buýt đi làm, ít sở thích, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Chi tiết nhỏ (Đà Nẵng, Nhật Bản...) là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật khi trả lời lại để mình chấm.

topics.title: Travelling

qs.q: Do you like to travel?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích đi du lịch không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. Travelling helps me relax after a stressful week at work. I also like trying new food in different places.
qs.a7: Yes, I do. It's a great way to recharge after a stressful week of deadlines, and I love trying local dishes wherever I go.
qs.grammar: *It's a great way to + V* → "It's a great way **to recharge**." Áp dụng: *Walking is a great way to stay fit.*

qs.q: Do you often travel by air?
qs.vi: Bạn có thường đi máy bay không?
qs.a6: No, not often. I usually travel by coach or by train inside Vietnam because it's cheaper. I only take a plane for long trips.
qs.a7: Not really. Flying is rather pricey, so for domestic trips I normally go by coach or train. I only book a flight when the destination is far away.
qs.grammar: *only + V* → "I **only book** a flight when..." (đặt "only" ngay trước động từ).

qs.q: How long was the longest trip you took?
qs.vi: Chuyến đi dài nhất của bạn kéo dài bao lâu?
qs.a6: My longest trip was about one week, to Da Nang and Hoi An. It was fun, and I took many photos.
qs.a7: That would be a week-long trip to Da Nang and Hoi An a couple of years ago. It was a bit tiring, but totally worth it. The beaches were stunning.

vocab.m: chuyến đi kéo dài một tuần
vocab.u: Số ít, có gạch nối: ✗ "a weeks-long"

qs.grammar: *Quá khứ đơn + mốc thời gian* → "a trip **a couple of years ago**." Không dùng present perfect với "ago".

qs.q: Which country would you like to travel to in the future?
qs.vi: Bạn muốn đi du lịch nước nào trong tương lai?
qs.a6: I'd like to go to Japan. I like Japanese culture, and I want to see the cherry blossoms in spring.
qs.a7: Japan is top of my list. I'm fascinated by its culture, and I'd love to see the cherry blossoms in spring. I've also heard that the food and public transport there are fantastic.
qs.grammar: *I've heard that + mệnh đề* (nghe nói) → dùng khi chưa từng trải nghiệm.

qs.q: Would you like to travel to space?
qs.vi: Bạn có muốn du hành vào vũ trụ không?
qs.a6: No, I wouldn't. It sounds dangerous and very expensive. I prefer to stay on Earth and watch space documentaries.
qs.a7: Honestly, no. It's far too risky and it costs a fortune. I'd rather stay on Earth and enjoy space through documentaries.
qs.grammar: *I'd rather + V (than + V)* → "I'd rather stay home than travel to space."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định dùng trong bài mẫu (theo hồ sơ của bạn): IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, sống ngoại thành, đi xe buýt đi làm, ít sở thích, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Chi tiết nhỏ (Đà Nẵng, Nhật Bản...) là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật khi trả lời lại để mình chấm.

topics.title: Paper / Writing Letters

qs.q: Do you often write things?
qs.vi: Bạn có thường viết lách không?
qs.a6: Not really. At work I mostly type reports and emails. At home I sometimes write notes or a to-do list by hand.
qs.a7: Not by hand, no. Most of my writing is typing, like bug reports and emails. But I do jot down to-do lists and reminders in a notebook, which helps me stay on top of things.

vocab.m: nắm bắt, kiểm soát mọi việc

qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ "which" nói về cả ý trước* → "I jot down lists, **which** helps me stay organised."

qs.q: Do you prefer to write by hand or write using a computer?
qs.vi: Bạn thích viết tay hay viết bằng máy tính?
qs.a6: I prefer using a computer because it's faster and easier to correct mistakes. But when I want to remember something, I write it by hand.
qs.a7: I'd go for the computer, as it's quicker and I can fix mistakes with a click. That said, writing by hand helps me remember things better, so I use a pen when I'm studying.

vocab.u: Đã dùng ở các file trước

qs.grammar: *So sánh hơn* → "quicker", "easier", "better". Tính từ ngắn + **-er**; tính từ dài dùng **more** (more convenient).

qs.q: Do you think computers might one day replace handwriting?
qs.vi: Máy tính có thể thay thế chữ viết tay vào một ngày nào đó không?
qs.a6: I don't think so. Maybe people will write less by hand, but handwriting is still important, especially for children at school.
qs.a7: I doubt it. People will probably write by hand less and less, but I think handwriting will survive, since children still need it to learn to write properly and to develop their own style.

vocab.u: Trả lời ngắn gọn, tự nhiên

qs.grammar: *will + probably/maybe* để dự đoán → "People **will probably** write less." (probably đứng sau will).

qs.q: When do children begin to write in your country?
qs.vi: Ở nước bạn, trẻ em bắt đầu tập viết khi nào?
qs.a6: Children start learning to write when they go to primary school, at about six years old. Some start earlier in kindergarten.
qs.a7: Usually at around six, when they start primary school. Some kids get a head start in kindergarten, where they learn to trace letters and write their own names.
qs.grammar: *start + V-ing / to V* đều đúng → "start learning / start to learn".

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Các chi tiết như "chị gái", "mất chìa khóa trên xe buýt" là ví dụ giả định. Bạn thay bằng chuyện thật của mình.

topics.title: Losing Things / Lost And Found

qs.q: Do you always bring a lot of keys with you?
qs.vi: Bạn có luôn mang nhiều chìa khóa không?
qs.a6: No, I don't. I only carry two keys, my house key and my office access card. I don't like heavy things in my pocket.
qs.a7: Not at all. I like to travel light, so I only carry my house key and my office access card. Carrying lots of keys would just weigh me down.
qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 2 rút gọn* → "Carrying lots of keys **would** weigh me down." (giả định, không có thật)

qs.q: Have you ever lost your keys?
qs.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ làm mất chìa khóa chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, once. I lost my house key on the bus, and I had to wait for my mother to come home. It was very annoying.
qs.a7: Yes, it happened once. I must have dropped my key on the bus, and I ended up waiting outside for an hour until my mum got home. I've been extra careful ever since.
qs.grammar: *Present perfect* → "I**'ve been** extra careful ever since." Dùng khi hành động kéo dài từ quá khứ đến hiện tại.

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Các chi tiết như "chị gái", "mất chìa khóa trên xe buýt" là ví dụ giả định. Bạn thay bằng chuyện thật của mình.

topics.title: Being Polite / Politeness

qs.q: How did you learn to be polite as a child?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn học cách lịch sự như thế nào?
qs.a6: I learned it from my parents. They taught me to say "please" and "thank you", and to greet older people. I also learned by watching how they behaved.
qs.a7: Mainly from my parents. They drilled into me the habit of greeting elders and saying "please" and "thank you". I also picked it up by watching how they treated other people.
qs.grammar: *by + V-ing* → "I learned **by watching** them."

qs.q: Do you think being polite is very important?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ lịch sự là rất quan trọng không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think it's very important. It shows respect, and people will like you more. It also makes work easier because we work in a team.
qs.a7: Definitely. Politeness shows respect and helps build good relationships. In my job, I often have to report bugs to developers, so being polite helps avoid unnecessary tension.
qs.grammar: *Gerund làm chủ ngữ* → "**Being polite** helps avoid tension." (V-ing đứng đầu câu).

qs.q: Who taught you to be polite when you were young?
qs.vi: Ai đã dạy bạn phép lịch sự khi còn nhỏ?
qs.a6: My parents, mainly my mother. My grandparents and my teachers also taught me, especially in primary school.
qs.a7: My mother, mostly. She was quite strict about manners. My grandparents and my primary school teachers also played a part.
qs.grammar: *"was quite strict"* – dùng "quite" để làm nhẹ tính từ, nghe tự nhiên hơn "very".

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Các chi tiết như "chị gái", "mất chìa khóa trên xe buýt" là ví dụ giả định. Bạn thay bằng chuyện thật của mình.

topics.title: Shoes

qs.q: What's your favourite type of shoes?
qs.vi: Loại giày yêu thích của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: I like sneakers the most. They are comfortable, so they're good for walking to the bus stop. I wear them almost every day.
qs.a7: Sneakers, hands down. They're comfortable enough for the walk to the bus stop, and they go with almost anything I wear. I practically live in them.
qs.grammar: *adj + enough for* → "comfortable **enough for** the walk." (enough đứng sau tính từ)

qs.q: Do you know anyone who likes to buy a lot of shoes?
qs.vi: Bạn có biết ai thích mua nhiều giày không?
qs.a6: Yes, my sister. She has more than twenty pairs of shoes. She always says she needs a new pair for every outfit.
qs.a7: Yes, my sister is a real shoe addict. She owns over twenty pairs and still claims she has nothing to wear. She says she needs a different pair for every outfit.
qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ "who"* → "anyone **who** likes to buy..." (who thay cho người).

qs.q: Have you ever bought shoes online?
qs.vi: Bạn đã từng mua giày online chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, a few times. It's convenient and there are many discounts. But sometimes the size is not right, so I have to return them.
qs.a7: Yes, a few times. It's convenient, and you can often find good deals. The downside is that the size doesn't always fit, so I've had to send a pair back once or twice.
qs.grammar: *have had to + V* (đã phải) → "I**'ve had to** send a pair back."

qs.q: How often do you buy shoes?
qs.vi: Bạn mua giày thường xuyên không?
qs.a6: I buy shoes about two times a year. I don't like shopping very much, so I only buy when my old shoes are worn out.
qs.a7: Only about twice a year. I'm not a big shopper, so I tend to replace a pair only when it's worn out. I prefer to buy one good pair rather than several cheap ones.
qs.grammar: *prefer A rather than B / prefer to V rather than V* → "I prefer to buy one good pair **rather than** several cheap ones."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân. Các chi tiết như "chị gái", "mất chìa khóa trên xe buýt" là ví dụ giả định. Bạn thay bằng chuyện thật của mình.

topics.title: Advertisements

qs.q: Are there many advertisements in your country?
qs.vi: Ở nước bạn có nhiều quảng cáo không?
qs.a6: Yes, there are a lot. You can see them on the street, on TV and especially on social media. Sometimes there are too many.
qs.a7: Yes, loads. They're plastered all over the streets, on TV and, above all, on social media. Sometimes it feels like you just can't escape them.
qs.grammar: *"It feels like + mệnh đề"* → "It feels like you can't escape them." Dùng để diễn tả cảm giác.

qs.q: Why do you think there are so many advertisements now?
qs.vi: Tại sao bạn nghĩ hiện nay có nhiều quảng cáo như vậy?
qs.a6: Because companies want to sell more products. Also, many people use the internet and phones, so it's easy for companies to reach customers.
qs.a7: I think it's down to competition. Companies are fighting for people's attention, and since almost everyone is glued to their phones, it's easier than ever to reach customers.
qs.grammar: *So sánh nhất kiểu "than ever"* → "easier **than ever**", "busier than ever".

qs.q: What are the various places where we see advertisements?
qs.vi: Chúng ta thấy quảng cáo ở những nơi nào?
qs.a6: We see them on billboards, on buses, on TV and on websites. Also in shopping malls and in phone apps.
qs.a7: Pretty much everywhere: billboards along the roads, on the sides of buses, on TV and, of course, pop-ups on websites and in apps.

vocab.p: on the side of a bus

qs.grammar: *Giới từ cho nơi chốn* → **on** TV / **on** a bus / **in** an app / **on** a website.

qs.q: How do you feel about advertisements?
qs.vi: Bạn cảm thấy thế nào về quảng cáo?
qs.a6: I feel a bit annoyed, especially by video ads that I can't skip. But sometimes they're useful because I learn about new products.
qs.a7: To be honest, I find them rather irritating, especially unskippable video ads. Having said that, they can occasionally be useful for discovering new products, like skincare.
qs.grammar: *I find + O + adj* → "I **find them irritating**." Áp dụng: *I find my job challenging.*

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). Trường cấp 2 "ở ngoại thành Hà Nội" là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Secondary School

qs.q: Where do you go to school?
qs.vi: Bạn học trường nào? / Bạn đã học trường nào?
qs.a6: I'm not at school now, but I went to a secondary school in my district, in the suburbs of Hanoi. It was about ten minutes from my house.
qs.a7: I finished school a long time ago. I went to a state secondary school in my district, on the outskirts of Hanoi. It was only a ten-minute bike ride from my house.
qs.grammar: *Tính từ ghép số + danh từ số ít* → "a **ten-minute** ride", "a **two-hour** meeting".

qs.q: Do you think your school is good for every student?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ trường của bạn tốt cho mọi học sinh không?
qs.a6: I don't think so. The school was good for students who studied well, but it didn't have much support for weaker students or students with other talents like art.
qs.a7: Not entirely. It suited students who were strong academically, but there wasn't much support for those who struggled or who had other talents, like art or sport.
qs.grammar: *"those who + V"* → "those **who** struggled" (những người mà...).

qs.q: What changes do you want to make in your school?
qs.vi: Bạn muốn thay đổi điều gì ở trường của mình?
qs.a6: I'd like the school to have better facilities, like a modern computer room. I'd also reduce homework so students have more free time.
qs.a7: If I could, I'd upgrade the facilities, especially the computer lab, and cut down on homework so that students would have more time to relax and develop their interests.

vocab.m: nâng cấp cơ sở vật chất

qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 2* → "**If I could**, I'**d** upgrade the facilities." Dùng cho mong muốn không có thật.

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). Trường cấp 2 "ở ngoại thành Hà Nội" là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Rubbish / Recycling

qs.q: Do you recycle now? Why?
qs.vi: Hiện nay bạn có tái chế không? Tại sao?
qs.a6: Yes, I do a little. I separate plastic bottles and paper from other rubbish because I want to protect the environment.
qs.a7: Yes, to a certain extent. I separate plastic bottles and paper from the general waste, because I want to do my bit for the environment, even if it's not much.

vocab.m: ở một mức độ nào đó

qs.grammar: *even if + mệnh đề* (dù cho) → "even if it's not much."

qs.q: Did you recycle when you were a kid?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn có tái chế không?
qs.a6: Not really. When I was a kid, my family didn't recycle much. We sold old paper and bottles to a collector for a little money.
qs.a7: Not in the way we do now. Back then, my family used to sell old newspapers and bottles to a scrap collector for some pocket money, rather than recycling for the environment.

vocab.u: Sau "used to" dùng V nguyên mẫu

qs.grammar: *used to + V* → "my family **used to sell** old newspapers." Phủ định: *didn't use to*.

qs.q: Will you recycle in the future?
qs.vi: Trong tương lai bạn có tái chế không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. I will try to recycle more because rubbish is a big problem in big cities.
qs.a7: Definitely. As the waste problem gets worse, I think I'll have to be more serious about sorting my rubbish, and I'd like to cut down on plastic as well.
qs.grammar: *As + mệnh đề* (khi/khi mà, diễn tả sự thay đổi dần) → "As the problem gets worse, ..."

qs.q: What kind of things do you recycle?
qs.vi: Bạn tái chế những loại đồ nào?
qs.a6: I recycle plastic bottles, paper and cardboard boxes. Sometimes I also give old clothes to charity.
qs.a7: Mostly plastic bottles, paper and the cardboard boxes from my online orders. I also donate old clothes to charity instead of throwing them away.
qs.grammar: *instead of + V-ing* → "instead of **throwing** them away."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). Trường cấp 2 "ở ngoại thành Hà Nội" là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Remembering Names

qs.q: Is it easy for you to remember names?
qs.vi: Bạn có dễ nhớ tên người khác không?
qs.a6: No, it's not easy for me. I remember faces better than names. I often forget a name just after I meet someone.
qs.a7: Not really. I'm better with faces than names, so I tend to forget someone's name almost as soon as I hear it. It can get quite embarrassing.
qs.grammar: *so sánh hơn* → "better **with** faces **than** names."

qs.q: Will you forget other people's names if others forget your name?
qs.vi: Nếu người khác quên tên bạn, bạn có quên tên họ không?
qs.a6: No, I won't. I don't mind if others forget my name, because I know it's hard to remember. I just tell them again.
qs.a7: No, I wouldn't take it personally. Since I often forget names myself, I understand. I'd simply remind them, and we'd probably laugh about it.

vocab.m: để bụng, cho là nhắm vào mình

qs.grammar: *would + V* khi nói giả định → "I **wouldn't take** it personally."

qs.q: How can you strengthen your memory?
qs.vi: Làm thế nào để cải thiện trí nhớ?
qs.a6: I try to repeat the name in the conversation. For example, I say "Nice to meet you, Lan". I also write names in my phone.
qs.a7: One trick is to repeat the name right away, such as "Nice to meet you, Lan". I also jot it down in my phone with a note about where we met. Getting enough sleep helps as well.
qs.grammar: *"One trick is to + V"* → mẫu câu chỉ cách làm: *One way to relax is to listen to music.*

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). Trường cấp 2 "ở ngoại thành Hà Nội" là giả định, bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Tiredness

qs.q: Do you often feel tired?
qs.vi: Bạn có thường cảm thấy mệt không?
qs.a6: Yes, quite often. My work is stressful, and I spend a long time on the bus every day, so I'm often exhausted in the evening.
qs.a7: Yes, fairly often. Between a demanding job and a long commute, I'm usually drained by the evening.

vocab.m: Vì cả X lẫn Y nên...

qs.grammar: *Tính từ cảm xúc đuôi -ed vs -ing* → "I'm **exhausted**" (người) / "the job is **exhausting**" (vật).

qs.q: When would you feel tired?
qs.vi: Bạn thường thấy mệt vào lúc nào?
qs.a6: I feel tired in the afternoon after lunch, and when I have a lot of deadlines. I also feel tired when I stay up late.
qs.a7: Mostly in the early afternoon, when lunch makes me sleepy, and in the run-up to a release, when deadlines pile up. Staying up late the night before doesn't help, either.
qs.grammar: *make + O + adj* → "lunch **makes me sleepy**."

qs.q: What do you do when you feel tired?
qs.vi: Khi mệt bạn làm gì?
qs.a6: I take a short rest, drink some tea or coffee, or go for a short walk. At home, I take a warm bath and go to bed early.
qs.a7: If I'm at work, I'll grab a coffee or take a short walk to wake myself up. At home, I prefer a warm shower and an early night.
qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 1* → "**If** I'm at work, I'**ll** grab a coffee."

qs.q: Do you think you get enough rest?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ mình nghỉ ngơi đủ không?
qs.a6: Not really. I usually sleep about six hours a night. I want to sleep more, but I go to bed late because of my phone.
qs.a7: Honestly, no. I get around six hours of sleep on weeknights, which isn't enough. I know I should go to bed earlier instead of scrolling on my phone.
qs.grammar: *should + V nguyên mẫu* → "I **should go** to bed earlier." (không "should to go")

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "ngủ 6 tiếng", "tai nghe earbuds" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Glasses

qs.q: Do people in your country wear sunglasses?
qs.vi: Người ở nước bạn có đeo kính râm không?
qs.a6: Yes, many people do, especially when riding motorbikes in summer. The sun in Vietnam can be very strong.
qs.a7: Yes, quite a lot, especially motorbike riders. The summer sun here is scorching, so sunglasses are both practical and fashionable.
qs.grammar: *both A and B* → "both **practical** and **fashionable**" (cùng loại từ).

qs.q: Where can you buy sunglasses?
qs.vi: Bạn có thể mua kính râm ở đâu?
qs.a6: You can buy them in shops, shopping malls or on the street. Many people also buy them online.
qs.a7: Almost anywhere, really, from street stalls and shopping malls to online platforms like Shopee. Prices vary a lot depending on the brand.
qs.grammar: *depending on + N* → "depending on the brand."

qs.q: Do you like to wear sunglasses?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích đeo kính râm không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. They protect my eyes from the sun, and I think they make me look cool. I wear them when I go out on weekends.
qs.a7: Yes, I do. They shield my eyes from the glare and, I must admit, they make me look a bit cooler. I usually wear them when I go out at the weekend.
qs.grammar: *look + adj* → "make me **look cooler**."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "ngủ 6 tiếng", "tai nghe earbuds" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Food

qs.q: What kinds of meals do you like?
qs.vi: Bạn thích những loại bữa ăn nào?
qs.a6: I like simple Vietnamese meals, like rice with fish and vegetables. They're healthy, and I like the taste. I also like noodle soup, like pho.
qs.a7: I'm a fan of home-style Vietnamese meals, such as rice with grilled fish and boiled vegetables. They're light and healthy. And, of course, you can't go wrong with a bowl of pho.
qs.grammar: *I'm a fan of + N* → "I'm a fan of Vietnamese food." (không "fan with")

qs.q: Do you often have dinner with your family or friends?
qs.vi: Bạn có thường ăn tối với gia đình hoặc bạn bè không?
qs.a6: I usually have dinner with my family. We eat together at home because it's a good time to talk. With friends, I only eat out once in a while.
qs.a7: Most days, I have dinner with my family. It's the one time of day when we can all sit down and catch up. I only eat out with friends once in a blue moon.
qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ "when"* → "the one time of day **when** we can sit down."

qs.q: When do you usually eat dinner?
qs.vi: Bạn thường ăn tối lúc mấy giờ?
qs.a6: I usually eat dinner at about seven o'clock, after I get home from work. Sometimes it's later when I'm stuck in traffic.
qs.a7: Around seven, give or take, depending on how bad the traffic is. Since I live in the suburbs, I often get home quite late.
qs.grammar: *Câu hỏi gián tiếp* → "depending on **how bad the traffic is**" (không đảo: ✗ how bad is the traffic).

qs.q: Are there any fruits or vegetables you don't like? Why?
qs.vi: Có loại trái cây/rau nào bạn không thích không? Tại sao?
qs.a6: Yes, I don't like durian because of its strong smell. I also don't like bitter melon because it tastes very bitter.
qs.a7: Yes, durian, for one thing. I can't stand the smell. Bitter melon is another one I avoid because of its sharp, bitter taste, although I know it's healthy.
qs.grammar: *although + mệnh đề* → "**although** I know it's healthy."

qs.q: What is your favourite cuisine?
qs.vi: Nền ẩm thực yêu thích của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: My favourite is Vietnamese cuisine. It has a lot of fresh vegetables and herbs, and it tastes balanced. I also like Korean food.
qs.a7: Vietnamese cuisine, hands down. It's all about fresh herbs and a good balance of flavours. Korean food comes a close second, particularly grilled meat.
qs.grammar: *It's all about + N* → "It's all about fresh herbs." (nhấn mạnh điều cốt lõi)

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "ngủ 6 tiếng", "tai nghe earbuds" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Headphones

qs.q: Is wearing headphones comfortable?
qs.vi: Đeo tai nghe có thoải mái không?
qs.a6: Yes, it is, if the headphones are light. But if I wear them for a long time, my ears feel hot and sore.
qs.a7: It depends. A lightweight pair is fine, but if I wear them for hours, my ears start to get sore and warm.
qs.grammar: *start to + V* → "my ears **start to get** sore."

qs.q: Do you use headphones?
qs.vi: Bạn có dùng tai nghe không?
qs.a6: Yes, I use them every day. I listen to music or podcasts on the bus to work.
qs.a7: Yes, pretty much every day. They're a lifesaver on the bus, since I can tune out the noise and listen to music or podcasts.
qs.grammar: *since + lý do* → "since I can tune out the noise."

qs.q: What type of headphones do you use?
qs.vi: Bạn dùng loại tai nghe nào?
qs.a6: I use wireless earbuds. They are small and easy to carry, so they're good for travelling.
qs.a7: I use wireless earbuds. They're compact and easy to carry around, which is ideal for commuting.

vocab.m: tai nghe không dây nhét tai

qs.grammar: *"which" cho cả mệnh đề* → "..., **which** is ideal for commuting."

qs.q: When would you use headphones?
qs.vi: Bạn dùng tai nghe vào lúc nào?
qs.a6: I use them on the bus, when I exercise, and when I study English listening. I also use them for online meetings.
qs.a7: Mainly during my commute, while exercising, and when I'm practising English listening. I also put them on for online meetings so I don't disturb anyone.
qs.grammar: *Liệt kê song song* → "during X, while Y-ing, and when Z" (giữ cấu trúc cân đối).

qs.q: In what conditions would you not use headphones?
qs.vi: Trong hoàn cảnh nào bạn không dùng tai nghe?
qs.a6: I don't use them when I'm crossing the road, because it's dangerous. I also don't use them when I'm talking with my family.
qs.a7: I wouldn't use them while crossing the road or riding a motorbike, as I need to hear what's going on around me. Wearing them at family meals would also feel rude.
qs.grammar: *Gerund làm chủ ngữ* → "**Wearing** them at family meals would feel rude."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "ngủ 6 tiếng", "tai nghe earbuds" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Watches

qs.q: How often do you wear a watch?
qs.vi: Bạn có thường đeo đồng hồ không?
qs.a6: I wear a watch almost every day. It's easy to check the time, and it also looks good with my clothes.
qs.a7: Almost every day. It's handy for checking the time at a glance, and since I care about my appearance, I think a good watch finishes off an outfit.
qs.grammar: *It's + adj + for + V-ing* → "It's handy **for checking** the time."

qs.q: What was your first watch like?
qs.vi: Chiếc đồng hồ đầu tiên của bạn như thế nào?
qs.a6: It was a small plastic watch with a cartoon on it. My parents bought it for me when I was in primary school.
qs.a7: It was a cheap digital watch with a cartoon character on the face, which my parents bought me when I started primary school. I was so proud of it.
qs.grammar: *"which" bổ nghĩa cho vật* → "a digital watch, **which** my parents bought me."

qs.q: What kind of watches do you like to wear?
qs.vi: Bạn thích đeo loại đồng hồ nào?
qs.a6: I like simple watches with a black or silver colour. They look clean, and they go with everything.
qs.a7: I'm into minimalist designs, with a plain dial and a leather or metal strap. They look smart without being flashy.
qs.grammar: *without + being + adj* → "smart **without being** flashy."

qs.q: Do people still wear watches in your country?
qs.vi: Người ở nước bạn còn đeo đồng hồ không?
qs.a6: Yes, many people still do. But young people use their phones to check the time. Smartwatches are also popular now.
qs.a7: Yes, though fewer than before. Many young people just check their phones, but watches have become more of a fashion accessory, and smartwatches are very popular.
qs.grammar: *Present perfect nói về thay đổi* → "watches **have become** more of a fashion accessory."

qs.q: Did you receive any watch as a gift when you were a child?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn có được tặng đồng hồ không?
qs.a6: Yes, my first watch was a gift from my parents on my birthday. I remember I was very happy.
qs.a7: Yes, my very first watch was a birthday present from my parents. I remember being over the moon and showing it off to all my friends.
qs.grammar: *remember + V-ing* (nhớ chuyện đã xảy ra) → "I remember **being** over the moon."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "kiểu đồng hồ tối giản", "gương soi toàn thân" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Cars / Driving

qs.q: Will you buy an expensive car in the future?
qs.vi: Trong tương lai bạn có mua xe đắt tiền không?
qs.a6: No, I don't think so. A car is expensive to buy and to keep, and parking in Hanoi is difficult. I'd rather save money.
qs.a7: Probably not. Apart from the price tag, there are the running costs, and parking is a nightmare in Hanoi. I'd rather spend that money on travel.
qs.grammar: *I'd rather + V* → "I'd rather spend that money on travel."

qs.q: Do you think car colours are important?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ màu xe quan trọng không?
qs.a6: A little. I think white and black cars look clean and are easy to sell later. But the colour is not the most important thing for me.
qs.a7: To some extent, yes. White and black are classic and easy to resell, but for me, comfort and reliability matter far more than colour.
qs.grammar: *far + so sánh hơn* → "matter **far more** than colour."

qs.q: Did you enjoy travelling by car when you were a kid?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn có thích đi ô tô không?
qs.a6: Yes, I did. Sometimes my family travelled by car on holidays. I liked looking out the window and eating snacks.
qs.a7: Yes, I loved it. On family holidays, I'd sit by the window, watching the scenery go by and munching on snacks. It felt like a real adventure.

vocab.m: một cuộc phiêu lưu thực sự

qs.grammar: *would + V* kể thói quen quá khứ → "I'**d sit** by the window."

qs.q: What types of cars do you like?
qs.vi: Bạn thích loại xe nào?
qs.a6: I like small SUVs. They are comfortable, and they're good for both the city and long trips.
qs.a7: I'm partial to compact SUVs. They're roomy enough for a family but still easy to handle in the city.
qs.grammar: *adj + enough for + N* → "roomy **enough for** a family."

qs.q: Do you prefer to be a driver or the passenger?
qs.vi: Bạn thích làm tài xế hay hành khách?
qs.a6: I prefer to be a passenger. I can relax, look at my phone or take a nap. Driving in Hanoi is stressful.
qs.a7: Passenger, no question. I can switch off, catch up on podcasts or even doze off, whereas driving in Hanoi's traffic is nerve-racking.

vocab.m: thư giãn, tắt "chế độ làm việc"

qs.grammar: *whereas* để đối lập → "I can relax, **whereas** driving is nerve-racking."

qs.q: What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?
qs.vi: Bạn thường làm gì khi kẹt xe?
qs.a6: I listen to music or podcasts. Sometimes I use my phone to check the news. I try to stay calm.
qs.a7: I put on a podcast or some music to take my mind off it. If I'm on the bus, I just try to stay patient, because getting angry won't make the jam clear any faster.
qs.grammar: *V-ing làm chủ ngữ* → "**Getting** angry won't help."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "kiểu đồng hồ tối giản", "gương soi toàn thân" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Websites

qs.q: What kinds of websites do you usually use?
qs.vi: Bạn thường dùng loại website nào?
qs.a6: I mostly use websites for work, like Jira and Google. I also use YouTube to learn English and online shopping sites like Shopee.
qs.a7: Mostly work-related ones like Jira and Confluence, plus Google and YouTube, which I use for English lessons. I also browse Shopee when I need skincare products.
qs.grammar: *"ones" thay danh từ* → "work-related **ones**" (= work-related websites), tránh lặp từ.

qs.q: What changes compared to the past?
qs.vi: So với trước đây, websites có gì thay đổi?
qs.a6: Websites are more modern and easier to use now. They work well on phones, and they have more videos and pictures.
qs.a7: They've become a lot more user-friendly and visual. Back then, pages were mostly text and designed for computers, whereas now they're responsive on phones and packed with video.
qs.grammar: *"a lot more + adj"* → "a lot **more** user-friendly." Dạng so sánh với "a lot / much / far".

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "kiểu đồng hồ tối giản", "gương soi toàn thân" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Mirrors

qs.q: Do you like looking at yourself in the mirror? How often?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích soi gương không? Bao lâu một lần?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. I look in the mirror several times a day, mainly in the morning before work. I like to check my face and hair.
qs.a7: I suppose so. I check myself in the mirror several times a day, mostly in the morning when I'm getting ready. I like to make sure my hair and skin look okay before leaving home.
qs.grammar: *before + V-ing* → "before **leaving** home."

qs.q: Have you ever bought mirrors?
qs.vi: Bạn đã bao giờ mua gương chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, I bought a full-length mirror for my room. It's very useful for checking my outfit.
qs.a7: Yes, I picked up a full-length mirror for my bedroom a while ago. It comes in handy when I want to check my outfit before heading out.
qs.grammar: *Quá khứ đơn + a while ago* → "I **picked up** a mirror **a while ago**."

qs.q: Would you use mirrors to decorate your room?
qs.vi: Bạn có dùng gương để trang trí phòng không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. Mirrors make a small room look bigger and brighter. A nice mirror can also look very stylish.
qs.a7: Absolutely. A well-placed mirror can make a small room feel bigger and brighter, and a stylish frame adds a touch of character.
qs.grammar: *make + O + adj* → "make a room **feel bigger**."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài. Chi tiết như "kiểu đồng hồ tối giản", "gương soi toàn thân" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Parks

qs.q: Did you like going to parks as a child?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn có thích đi công viên không?
qs.a6: Yes, I did. I often went to the park near my house with my friends. We played football and ran around.
qs.a7: Yes, a lot. There was a small park near my house where my friends and I would kick a ball around until it got dark.
qs.grammar: *would + V* (thói quen quá khứ) → "my friends and I **would kick** a ball around."

qs.q: Do you still like going to parks now?
qs.vi: Bây giờ bạn còn thích đi công viên không?
qs.a6: Yes, but not as often as before. I go to the park on weekends to walk and relax. It helps me reduce stress after work.
qs.a7: Yes, though not as often as I used to. I still enjoy an easy stroll there at the weekend. It's a good way to switch off from a busy week.

vocab.p: not as often as I used to

qs.grammar: *as + adv + as* → "not **as often as** before."

qs.q: Would you like to see more parks in your city?
qs.vi: Bạn có muốn thấy nhiều công viên hơn trong thành phố không?
qs.a6: Yes, definitely. Hanoi has many buildings and not enough green space. More parks would make the air cleaner.
qs.a7: Definitely. Hanoi is getting more and more crowded, and there's a real shortage of green space. More parks would give people somewhere to unwind and help clean up the air.
qs.grammar: *so sánh kép* → "more and more crowded."

qs.q: Are there any parks you want to go to in the future?
qs.vi: Bạn muốn đến công viên nào trong tương lai?
qs.a6: I'd like to visit Central Park in New York. I've seen it in many movies, and it looks big and beautiful.
qs.a7: Central Park in New York, I think. I've seen it in so many films that I'd love to stroll around it myself, particularly in autumn.
qs.grammar: *so + adj/many + that* (kết quả) → "so many films **that** I'd love to go."

qs.q: Would you prefer to play in a personal garden or a public garden?
qs.vi: Bạn thích chơi ở vườn riêng hay công viên công cộng?
qs.a6: I prefer a public park because it's bigger and free. A private garden is nice, but I don't have the space for one.
qs.a7: A public park, I'd say. It's much bigger, there's always something going on, and it doesn't need any upkeep. A private garden would be lovely, but I simply don't have room for one.

vocab.m: lúc nào cũng có hoạt động

qs.grammar: *would + adj (giả định)* → "A private garden **would be** lovely, but..."

qs.q: How are the parks today different from those you visited as a kid?
qs.vi: Công viên bây giờ khác gì so với hồi nhỏ?
qs.a6: Today's parks are cleaner and more modern. They have better lights, paths and sports equipment. Years ago, they were simpler and more natural.
qs.a7: They're a lot more modern now, with proper walking paths, lighting and exercise equipment. Back then, they were simpler and a bit run-down, but I'd say they had more character.
qs.grammar: *those + mệnh đề* → "those (parks) I visited as a kid."

qs.q: What do you like to do when visiting a park?
qs.vi: Bạn thích làm gì khi đến công viên?
qs.a6: I like walking and listening to music. Sometimes I sit on a bench and watch people exercise.
qs.a7: Mostly walking and listening to podcasts. Occasionally I just find a bench and people-watch, which is surprisingly relaxing.
qs.grammar: *like + V-ing* → "I like **walking**."

qs.q: Would you like to play in a public garden or park?
qs.vi: Bạn có muốn chơi ở vườn/công viên công cộng không?
qs.a6: Yes, I would. A park has space for many activities, like jogging or badminton, and I can meet other people there.
qs.a7: Sure. Parks offer plenty of room for activities like jogging or badminton, and it's a nice chance to meet new people.
qs.grammar: *offer + N + for + N* → "offer room **for** activities."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). "Em trai", "thích nhạc pop/K-pop" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật. Nhóm này dài (25 câu), bạn có thể học làm 2 buổi: Parks + Shopping, rồi Tidy + Music.

topics.title: Shopping

qs.q: Do you like going shopping?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích đi mua sắm không?
qs.a6: Not really. I don't like crowded places, and I get tired easily. But I enjoy buying skincare products and clothes sometimes.
qs.a7: Not a huge fan, to be honest. I find malls crowded and tiring. That said, I do enjoy picking out skincare products and the odd new shirt.
qs.grammar: *I find + O + adj* → "I find malls **crowded**."

qs.q: Do you shop online?
qs.vi: Bạn có mua sắm online không?
qs.a6: Yes, I shop online a lot. It's convenient and there are many discounts. I usually buy skincare products and clothes.
qs.a7: Yes, quite often. It saves me a lot of time, and I can compare prices and read reviews before I buy. Skincare and clothes are my main purchases.
qs.grammar: *save + O + time* → "It **saves me** a lot of time."

qs.q: Does shopping take you a lot of time?
qs.vi: Mua sắm có tốn nhiều thời gian của bạn không?
qs.a6: Not much when I shop online, maybe thirty minutes. But when I go to a mall, it can take half a day.
qs.a7: Online, hardly any, since I know what I want. In a mall it's a different story. It can easily eat up half a day.
qs.grammar: *hardly any + N* mang nghĩa phủ định, **không** thêm "not".

qs.q: What is the best part about shopping?
qs.vi: Điều tuyệt nhất khi mua sắm là gì?
qs.a6: The best part is finding a good price. I feel happy when I find a nice item on sale.
qs.a7: For me, it's the thrill of finding a bargain. Nothing beats snapping up something I've wanted at half price.
qs.grammar: *Nothing beats + V-ing* → "Nothing beats **finding** a bargain."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). "Em trai", "thích nhạc pop/K-pop" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật. Nhóm này dài (25 câu), bạn có thể học làm 2 buổi: Parks + Shopping, rồi Tidy + Music.

topics.title: Keeping Things Tidy

qs.q: Are you a tidy person?
qs.vi: Bạn có phải người ngăn nắp không?
qs.a6: Yes, I am. I like my room to be clean. I always put things back in place. It helps me find things easily.
qs.a7: Yes, I'd say I'm pretty tidy. I can't relax in a messy room, so I make a point of putting things back where they belong. It saves me time looking for stuff.

vocab.m: cố ý, luôn chú ý làm

qs.grammar: *save + O + time + V-ing* → "saves me time **looking** for stuff."

qs.q: Are all of your family members tidy?
qs.vi: Mọi người trong gia đình bạn có ngăn nắp không?
qs.a6: Not all of them. My mother is very tidy, but my brother is not. His room is always messy.
qs.a7: Not really. My mother is spotless, but my brother is the opposite. His room looks like a bomb has hit it.

vocab.p: look like a bomb has hit it

qs.grammar: *Not all of + N* → "**Not all of** them are tidy." (phủ định một phần)

qs.q: Are you tidier at home or at work/school?
qs.vi: Bạn ngăn nắp ở nhà hay ở chỗ làm hơn?
qs.a6: I'm tidier at home. At work, I have many documents and tasks, so my desk is a bit messy.
qs.a7: At home, I'd say. At work, my desk tends to get cluttered with notes and cables, especially around a release. My room is my own space, so I keep it in order.
qs.grammar: *tend to + V* → "my desk **tends to get** cluttered."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). "Em trai", "thích nhạc pop/K-pop" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật. Nhóm này dài (25 câu), bạn có thể học làm 2 buổi: Parks + Shopping, rồi Tidy + Music.

topics.title: Music

qs.q: Do you like listening to music?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích nghe nhạc không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. Music helps me relax after a long day.
qs.a7: Yes, very much. It's the easiest way I know to unwind after a long day.

vocab.u: đứng cuối: *I like it very much*

qs.grammar: *the + so sánh nhất + (that) I know* → "the easiest way **I know** to unwind."

qs.q: When do you listen to music?
qs.vi: Bạn nghe nhạc vào lúc nào?
qs.a6: I listen on the bus to work, when I exercise and before I sleep.
qs.a7: Mainly on my commute, when I'm working out, and sometimes before bed to wind down.
qs.grammar: *Song song* → "on my commute, when I'm working out, and before bed."

qs.q: Did you learn any instruments?
qs.vi: Bạn có học nhạc cụ nào không?
qs.a6: No, I didn't. My family wasn't rich, and I didn't have time. I tried to play the recorder at school, but only for a short time.
qs.a7: No, never. We couldn't afford lessons, and I wasn't particularly musical anyway. I only played the recorder briefly at school.
qs.grammar: *couldn't + V* (quá khứ không thể) → "We **couldn't afford** lessons."

qs.q: Did you have any music classes in school?
qs.vi: Hồi đi học bạn có học môn âm nhạc không?
qs.a6: Yes, we had a music class once a week in primary school. We sang songs and learned some simple notes.
qs.a7: Yes, once a week in primary school. We sang together and learned to read basic musical notes, though I don't remember much now.
qs.grammar: *though ở cuối câu* → "...though I don't remember much now."

qs.q: Do you think it is necessary for children to have music classes?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ trẻ em cần học nhạc không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. Music helps children be creative and relax. It also teaches them teamwork if they play in a group.
qs.a7: I'd say so. Music boosts creativity and helps children de-stress, and playing in a group teaches them to cooperate.
qs.grammar: *teach + O + to + V* → "teaches them **to cooperate**."

qs.q: What do you think of Vietnamese traditional music?
qs.vi: Bạn nghĩ gì về âm nhạc truyền thống Việt Nam?
qs.a6: It's beautiful, but I don't listen to it often. It sounds calm and peaceful. Maybe I'll listen to it more when I'm older.
qs.a7: I find it soothing and rich in tradition, though I don't listen to it much. I tend to appreciate it more during Tet, when it's on everywhere.
qs.grammar: *I find it + adj* → "I find it **soothing**."

qs.q: How much time do you spend listening to music every day?
qs.vi: Mỗi ngày bạn dành bao nhiêu thời gian nghe nhạc?
qs.a6: About two hours a day, mostly on the bus.
qs.a7: Roughly two hours a day, most of it on the bus rides to and from work.

vocab.m: đi và về từ chỗ làm

qs.grammar: *most of + it/them* → "**most of it** is on the bus."

qs.q: What is your favourite kind of music?
qs.vi: Thể loại nhạc yêu thích của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: I like pop music, especially Vietnamese pop and some Korean pop. The songs are easy to listen to.
qs.a7: Pop, mainly Vietnamese and K-pop. The tunes are catchy and upbeat, which is perfect for the morning commute.
qs.grammar: *"which is perfect for..."* → mệnh đề quan hệ bổ sung ý.

qs.q: When did you start listening to this type of music?
qs.vi: Bạn bắt đầu nghe thể loại này từ khi nào?
qs.a6: I started in secondary school, when I had my first phone. My friends shared songs with me.
qs.a7: Around secondary school, when I got my first phone. My classmates would swap songs, and that's how I got into it.
qs.grammar: *"that's how"* → "that's how I got into it."

qs.q: How do you feel when you are listening to music?
qs.vi: Bạn cảm thấy thế nào khi nghe nhạc?
qs.a6: I feel relaxed and happy. Sometimes it also gives me energy for work.
qs.a7: It lifts my mood and takes the edge off a stressful day. Upbeat songs even give me a boost of energy.
qs.grammar: *give + O + N* → "give me a boost of energy."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, thích chăm sóc bản thân (skincare). "Em trai", "thích nhạc pop/K-pop" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật. Nhóm này dài (25 câu), bạn có thể học làm 2 buổi: Parks + Shopping, rồi Tidy + Music.

topics.title: Teachers

qs.q: Do you like any teacher of yours?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích thầy cô nào không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. I liked my English teacher in secondary school. She was kind, and she made lessons fun.
qs.a7: Yes, my secondary school English teacher in particular. She was patient and had a knack for making lessons fun, which is probably why I still care about English today.
qs.grammar: *"which is probably why..."* → nối ý nguyên nhân – kết quả.

qs.q: Do you still keep in touch with your teachers?
qs.vi: Bạn còn giữ liên lạc với thầy cô không?
qs.a6: Not really. I only contact one teacher on social media. Sometimes I send her a message on Teachers' Day.
qs.a7: Only one or two. I follow my old English teacher on Facebook, and I usually drop her a message on Vietnamese Teachers' Day. Apart from that, we've lost touch.
qs.grammar: *Present perfect* → "we**'ve lost** touch." (kết quả còn đến hiện tại)

qs.q: Do you think it's important to like your teacher?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ việc quý mến thầy cô là quan trọng không?
qs.a6: I think so. When I like a teacher, I'm more interested in the subject, and I study harder.
qs.a7: I think it is. If you like your teacher, you're more motivated and you're not afraid to ask questions, which makes a huge difference to your results.
qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 0/1* → "**If** you like your teacher, you're more motivated."

qs.q: Do you want to be a teacher?
qs.vi: Bạn có muốn làm giáo viên không?
qs.a6: No, I don't. I'm not patient enough, and I'm not good at speaking in front of many people. I prefer working with computers.
qs.a7: Not really. I don't have the patience for it, and standing in front of a class would make me nervous. I'm happier working behind a screen.
qs.grammar: *not + adj + enough* → "I'm **not patient enough**." (enough sau tính từ)

qs.q: What qualities should a good teacher have?
qs.vi: Một giáo viên tốt cần có những phẩm chất gì?
qs.a6: A good teacher should be patient, kind and knowledgeable. They also need to explain things clearly.
qs.a7: I think patience is number one, followed by solid subject knowledge and the ability to explain complex ideas in simple terms. A sense of humour helps, too.
qs.grammar: *followed by + N* → "patience, **followed by** knowledge."

qs.q: Do you have a favourite teacher?
qs.vi: Bạn có thầy cô yêu thích không?
qs.a6: Yes, my English teacher in secondary school. She encouraged me when I was weak, and she never got angry with students.
qs.a7: Yes, my English teacher at secondary school. She believed in me when my grades were poor, and she never made me feel stupid for asking questions.
qs.grammar: *never + quá khứ đơn* → "she **never made** me feel stupid." (Mẹo: câu này có thể dùng lại ý ở Q1)

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài (nên phần Clothes viết theo hướng chọn đồ gọn gàng, hợp dáng). "Cô giáo tiếng Anh cấp 2", "dùng Facebook/TikTok" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Social Media

qs.q: Do you like to use social media?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích dùng mạng xã hội không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. I use Facebook and TikTok to keep in touch with friends and watch videos.
qs.a7: Yes, I do, mainly Facebook and TikTok. They're a convenient way to stay in touch with friends and keep up with the news.
qs.grammar: *"a way to + V"* → "a convenient way **to stay** in touch."

qs.q: Do you think you or your friends use too much social media?
qs.vi: Bạn hoặc bạn bè có dùng mạng xã hội quá nhiều không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. I spend about two hours a day on it, and my friends are the same. Sometimes it wastes our time.
qs.a7: I'm afraid so. I spend a couple of hours a day scrolling, and my friends are no better. It's easy to lose track of time.
qs.grammar: *spend + time + V-ing* → "spend a couple of hours **scrolling**."

qs.q: Do you want to work in social media? Why?
qs.vi: Bạn có muốn làm việc trong lĩnh vực mạng xã hội không? Tại sao?
qs.a6: No, I don't. I'm interested in technology, not in marketing. I want to stay in IT.
qs.a7: Not really. I'm more into the technical side of things, so I'd rather stay in IT than move into marketing or content creation.
qs.grammar: *I'd rather + V than + V* → "I'd rather **stay** in IT than **move** into marketing."

qs.q: What's the most popular social media in Vietnam? Why?
qs.vi: Mạng xã hội nào phổ biến nhất ở Việt Nam? Tại sao?
qs.a6: I think Facebook and TikTok are the most popular. Facebook is used by many age groups, and TikTok is popular with young people. Zalo is also used a lot for messaging.
qs.a7: Facebook still tops the list, since people of all ages use it, but TikTok is catching on fast among the young. Zalo is also hugely popular for everyday messaging.
qs.grammar: *Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho xu hướng* → "TikTok **is catching on** fast."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài (nên phần Clothes viết theo hướng chọn đồ gọn gàng, hợp dáng). "Cô giáo tiếng Anh cấp 2", "dùng Facebook/TikTok" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Clothes

qs.q: What's your favourite colour of clothes?
qs.vi: Màu quần áo yêu thích của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: My favourite colours are black and white. They are simple and easy to wear with other colours.
qs.a7: I'm a big fan of neutral shades, like black, white and beige. They're easy to mix and match, and they never go out of style.
qs.grammar: *be a fan of + N* → "I'm a big fan **of** neutral shades."

qs.q: What kind of clothes do you never wear?
qs.vi: Bạn không bao giờ mặc loại quần áo nào?
qs.a6: I never wear very bright colours or clothes with big logos. They look too noisy for me.
qs.a7: I steer clear of anything too flashy, like neon colours or clothes with huge logos. They're just not my style.
qs.grammar: *anything + too + adj* → "anything too flashy."

qs.q: What kind of clothes do you usually wear?
qs.vi: Bạn thường mặc loại quần áo nào?
qs.a6: I usually wear a shirt and trousers to work, and sometimes jeans on Fridays. They look neat and comfortable.
qs.a7: For work I usually go for a plain shirt and trousers, which look neat without being too formal. I'm quite particular about how my clothes fit.
qs.grammar: *without being + adj* → "neat **without being** too formal."

qs.q: Do you wear the same style of clothes on weekdays and weekends?
qs.vi: Ngày thường và cuối tuần bạn có mặc cùng phong cách không?
qs.a6: No, they're different. On weekdays I wear a shirt and trousers. At weekends I wear T-shirts and jeans because they're more comfortable.
qs.a7: Not at all. During the week it's smart-casual, whereas at weekends I just throw on a T-shirt and jeans. Comfort comes first when I'm off duty.
qs.grammar: *whereas* → so sánh hai vế đối lập.

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài (nên phần Clothes viết theo hướng chọn đồ gọn gàng, hợp dáng). "Cô giáo tiếng Anh cấp 2", "dùng Facebook/TikTok" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Films

qs.q: What's your favourite kind of movie?
qs.vi: Thể loại phim yêu thích của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: I like action and science fiction movies. They are exciting, and the special effects are great.
qs.a7: I'm into action and sci-fi films. They're fast-paced, and the special effects are often jaw-dropping on a big screen.
qs.grammar: *be into + N* → "I'm into action films."

qs.q: Did you go to the cinema a lot when you were a child?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn có hay đi xem phim ở rạp không?
qs.a6: No, not a lot. There were no cinemas near my house, and my family was busy. I mostly watched films on TV.
qs.a7: Not really. There wasn't a cinema near where I lived back then, so we mostly watched films on TV at home. Going to the cinema was a special treat.
qs.grammar: *there was / there were* → "**There wasn't** a cinema." (số ít *wasn't*, số nhiều *weren't*)

qs.q: Which is more popular in your country, going to the cinema or watching movies at home?
qs.vi: Ở nước bạn, đi rạp hay xem ở nhà phổ biến hơn?
qs.a6: I think watching at home is more popular now. There are many streaming apps, and it's cheaper and more convenient.
qs.a7: These days, I'd say watching at home is more popular. Streaming services are cheap and convenient, though cinemas still attract crowds at weekends for the big-screen experience.
qs.grammar: *though + mệnh đề* → "..., **though** cinemas still attract crowds."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, thích chăm sóc bản thân và quan tâm vẻ ngoài (nên phần Clothes viết theo hướng chọn đồ gọn gàng, hợp dáng). "Cô giáo tiếng Anh cấp 2", "dùng Facebook/TikTok" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Dreams

qs.q: How long can you remember your dream when you wake up?
qs.vi: Bạn nhớ giấc mơ được bao lâu sau khi thức dậy?
qs.a6: Not for long. I usually remember it for a few minutes after I wake up, and then I forget it.
qs.a7: Only for a few minutes. The details fade quickly, and by the time I've brushed my teeth, it's gone.

vocab.u: Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành ở đây

qs.grammar: *by the time + present perfect* → "by the time **I've brushed** my teeth, it's gone."

qs.q: Do you like hearing others' dreams?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích nghe người khác kể giấc mơ không?
qs.a6: Yes, sometimes. Other people's dreams can be funny or strange. But if they're too long, I get bored.
qs.a7: Sometimes, yes. They can be hilarious or really bizarre. But when someone goes on and on about one, I lose interest.
qs.grammar: *"But when ..."* dùng để chuyển sang mặt tiêu cực của ý trước.

qs.q: Do you think dreams will affect life?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ giấc mơ ảnh hưởng đến cuộc sống không?
qs.a6: I think they can a little. If I have a bad dream, I feel uncomfortable in the morning. But most dreams don't change my life.
qs.a7: To a small degree, perhaps. A bad dream can leave me in a low mood the next morning, but I don't think dreams have any lasting impact on my life.
qs.grammar: *leave + O + adj/in a state* → "leave me **in a low mood**."

qs.q: Do you often have dreams at night?
qs.vi: Bạn có thường mơ vào ban đêm không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think I dream almost every night, but I only remember some of them, especially when I'm stressed.
qs.a7: I probably dream most nights, though I only recall them when I wake up in the middle of one, usually when I'm stressed.
qs.grammar: *"have a dream" ≠ "dream about"* → *have dreams* / *dream about work*.

qs.q: Have you had a bad dream before?
qs.vi: Bạn đã từng mơ ác mộng chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, many times. I once dreamed that I was late for an exam and I couldn't find the room. I woke up very scared.
qs.a7: Plenty of times. The classic one is dreaming that I'm late for an exam and can't find the room. I usually wake up in a cold sweat.
qs.grammar: *"dream that + mệnh đề"* → "dreaming **that** I'm late."

qs.q: What was the strangest dream you have had?
qs.vi: Giấc mơ kỳ lạ nhất bạn từng có là gì?
qs.a6: I once dreamed that I could fly over Hanoi like a bird. It was strange because I felt very free and happy.
qs.a7: Once, I dreamt I was flying over West Lake like a bird. It felt so real, and I was almost disappointed to wake up.
qs.grammar: *so + adj (nhấn mạnh)* → "It felt **so real**."

qs.q: What do you usually dream about?
qs.vi: Bạn thường mơ về điều gì?
qs.a6: I usually dream about work and my family. Sometimes I dream about bugs in the software, which is funny.
qs.a7: Mostly about work, believe it or not. I sometimes dream about bugs I can't reproduce, which tells me I'm thinking about work too much!
qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ cho cả ý* → "..., **which tells me** I'm thinking about work too much."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC, sống ngoại thành Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, ít sở thích. Ở topic City mình dùng Hà Nội (khớp hồ sơ của bạn). Các chi tiết như "mơ về bug", "đi Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: City

qs.q: Would you recommend your city to others?
qs.vi: Bạn có giới thiệu thành phố của mình cho người khác không?
qs.a6: Yes, I would. Hanoi has a long history, delicious food and friendly people. It's a nice place to visit.
qs.a7: Definitely. Hanoi has a rich history, fantastic street food and a charm you don't find elsewhere. It's well worth a visit, even for just a few days.
