vocab.p: a charm you don't find elsewhere

qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ lược "that"* → "a charm (that) you don't find elsewhere."

qs.q: What's the weather like where you live?
qs.vi: Thời tiết nơi bạn sống như thế nào?
qs.a6: It's hot and humid in summer and cold in winter. Autumn is the best season, because the weather is cool and dry.
qs.a7: We have four distinct seasons. Summers are sweltering and humid, winters can be bitterly cold, but autumn is the best, with crisp, cool weather.
qs.grammar: *Mùa dùng "in"* → "**in** summer / **in** winter."

qs.q: Are there people of different ages living in this city?
qs.vi: Thành phố có người ở nhiều độ tuổi không?
qs.a6: Yes, there are people of all ages. Many young people come to Hanoi to study and work, and there are also many older people.
qs.a7: Yes, a good mix. Lots of young people move here for university and jobs, while older residents have lived here for generations.
qs.grammar: *while* đối lập → "young people move here, **while** older residents have lived here for generations."

qs.q: Are the people friendly in the city?
qs.vi: Người dân thành phố có thân thiện không?
qs.a6: Yes, mostly. People in Hanoi are polite and helpful, but in busy areas they can look like they're in a hurry.
qs.a7: By and large, yes. Hanoians are polite and helpful once you get talking to them, although people can seem a bit hurried on busy streets.
qs.grammar: *seem + adj* → "people can **seem** hurried."

qs.q: Is the city friendly to children and old people?
qs.vi: Thành phố có thân thiện với trẻ em và người già không?
qs.a6: Not very. There aren't many playgrounds for children, and the pavements are crowded. But the parks around West Lake are nice for older people.
qs.a7: Not entirely. Playgrounds are in short supply, and crowded pavements make life hard for older people. That said, the areas around the lakes are great for a gentle walk.
qs.grammar: *make + N + adj* → "make life **hard** for older people."

qs.q: Do you often see your neighbours?
qs.vi: Bạn có hay gặp hàng xóm không?
qs.a6: Not often. I leave home early and come back late. I only see them at weekends.
qs.a7: Not really. I'm out early and home late, so I only bump into them at the weekend.
qs.grammar: *Rút gọn tự nhiên* → "I'm **out** early and **home** late."

qs.q: What city do you live in?
qs.vi: Bạn sống ở thành phố nào?
qs.a6: I live in Hanoi, in the suburbs. It's about one hour from the city centre by bus.
qs.a7: I live in Hanoi, on the outskirts, about an hour's bus ride from the city centre.
qs.grammar: *sở hữu cách chỉ thời gian* → "an **hour's** bus ride."

qs.q: Do you like this city? Why?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích thành phố này không? Tại sao?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. I like the food and the culture. But I don't like the traffic and the pollution.
qs.a7: On the whole, yes. I love the food and the culture, although the traffic and air pollution get on my nerves.
qs.grammar: *although* → "I love the food, **although** the traffic gets on my nerves."

qs.q: How long have you lived in this city?
qs.vi: Bạn đã sống ở thành phố này bao lâu?
qs.a6: I've lived in Hanoi all my life. I was born here.
qs.a7: All my life. I was born and raised here, so I can't imagine living anywhere else.
qs.grammar: *Present perfect + all my life* → "I**'ve lived** here all my life."

qs.q: Are there big changes in this city?
qs.vi: Thành phố có thay đổi lớn không?
qs.a6: Yes, there are many. There are more tall buildings, a new metro line and wider roads. The city is more modern now.
qs.a7: Huge ones. The skyline is full of high-rises, there's a metro line now, and many roads have been widened. It's a lot more modern, though the traffic has only got worse.

vocab.m: đường chân trời của thành phố

qs.grammar: *Present perfect bị động* → "roads **have been widened**."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC, sống ngoại thành Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, ít sở thích. Ở topic City mình dùng Hà Nội (khớp hồ sơ của bạn). Các chi tiết như "mơ về bug", "đi Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Outer Space

qs.q: Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?
qs.vi: Bạn đã từng tìm hiểu về vũ trụ và các vì sao chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, a little. I learned about the solar system in school, and sometimes I watch videos about space on YouTube.
qs.a7: A little. We covered the solar system at school, and I sometimes watch space documentaries online. It's fascinating to think how vast the universe is.
qs.grammar: *It's + adj + to + V* → "It's **fascinating to think** how vast the universe is."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC, sống ngoại thành Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, ít sở thích. Ở topic City mình dùng Hà Nội (khớp hồ sơ của bạn). Các chi tiết như "mơ về bug", "đi Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Art

qs.q: Do you like art?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích nghệ thuật không?
qs.a6: Yes, a little. I'm not an expert, but I enjoy looking at nice paintings and photos.
qs.a7: I do, although I'm no expert. I enjoy looking at paintings and photography. It's a nice change from staring at a screen all day.

vocab.m: thay đổi dễ chịu so với

qs.grammar: *although + mệnh đề* → "I do, **although** I'm no expert."

qs.q: Have you ever visited an art gallery?
qs.vi: Bạn đã từng đến phòng tranh chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, once or twice. I went to the Vietnam Fine Arts Museum in Hanoi with a friend. It was quiet and interesting.
qs.a7: Once or twice. I visited the Vietnam Fine Arts Museum in Hanoi with a friend. It was a peaceful way to spend an afternoon, though I couldn't tell you much about the artists.

vocab.p: a peaceful way to spend an afternoon
vocab.m: cách yên bình để trải qua buổi chiều

qs.grammar: *Quá khứ đơn kể trải nghiệm* → "I **visited**... It **was**..."

qs.q: Is there any art work on the wall in your room?
qs.vi: Trong phòng bạn có tác phẩm nghệ thuật nào treo tường không?
qs.a6: No, I don't. I only have a calendar and a few photos on my wall. But I'd like to put up a nice painting someday.
qs.a7: Not really, just a calendar and a few photos of family trips. I'd like to hang a nice print or two one day to brighten up the room.
qs.grammar: *I'd like to + V* → "I'd like to hang a nice print."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC, sống ngoại thành Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, ít sở thích. Ở topic City mình dùng Hà Nội (khớp hồ sơ của bạn). Các chi tiết như "mơ về bug", "đi Bảo tàng Mỹ thuật" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Singing

qs.q: Do you often sing?
qs.vi: Bạn có hay hát không?
qs.a6: Not often. I only sing when I'm alone, like in the shower or when I'm cleaning my room.
qs.a7: Not really. I only sing when nobody's around, like in the shower or while tidying my room.
qs.grammar: *while + V-ing* → "while **tidying** my room."

qs.q: When do you like to sing?
qs.vi: Bạn thích hát vào lúc nào?
qs.a6: I like to sing when I'm in a good mood or when I'm relaxing at home. Sometimes I sing with friends at karaoke.
qs.a7: When I'm in a good mood or just unwinding at home. Karaoke with friends is the one exception, where I really let loose.
qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ "where"* → "karaoke, **where** I really let loose."

qs.q: Is it difficult to sing well?
qs.vi: Hát hay có khó không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. You need a good voice and you need to practise a lot. It's also hard to sing high notes.
qs.a7: I'd say so. It takes natural talent as well as a lot of practice, especially to hit the high notes without your voice cracking.
qs.grammar: *It takes + N + as well as + N* → "It takes talent **as well as** practice."

qs.q: Do you want to be a singer?
qs.vi: Bạn có muốn làm ca sĩ không?
qs.a6: No, I don't. I'm not good at singing, and I don't like being famous. Singing is just for fun for me.
qs.a7: Not at all. I can't hold a tune, and I'd hate being in the spotlight. For me, singing is just for fun.
qs.grammar: *hate + V-ing* → "I'd hate **being** in the spotlight."

qs.q: What kinds of music do you like to sing?
qs.vi: Bạn thích hát loại nhạc nào?
qs.a6: I like to sing slow pop songs and old Vietnamese songs. They are easy to sing.
qs.a7: Slow ballads and old Vietnamese pop songs. They suit my voice, and the melodies are easy to follow.
qs.grammar: *easy to + V* → "easy **to follow**."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ít sở thích nổi trội. Với Singing và Sports, bài mẫu theo hướng "hát cho vui, đá cầu lông/bóng đá hồi nhỏ, cổ vũ đội tuyển". Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật nhé. Câu trả lời "không thích/không làm" vẫn tốt, miễn là có lý do và ví dụ.

topics.title: Evening

qs.q: Do you prefer studying in the morning or in the afternoon?
qs.vi: Bạn thích học vào buổi sáng hay buổi chiều?
qs.a6: I prefer studying in the morning because my head is clear. In the afternoon I feel sleepy.
qs.a7: The morning, definitely. My head is clear and there are fewer distractions. By the afternoon, I start to lose focus.
qs.grammar: *fewer + N đếm được* → "fewer distractions." (ít hơn)

qs.q: What do you usually do in the evening?
qs.vi: Buổi tối bạn thường làm gì?
qs.a6: I get home around seven, have dinner with my family, and then watch TV or study English for an hour. I go to bed at about eleven.
qs.a7: After getting home and having dinner with my family, I usually spend an hour studying English, then wind down by watching a series or scrolling through my phone before bed around eleven.
qs.grammar: *After + V-ing, S + V* → "**After getting** home, I have dinner."

qs.q: What did you do in the evening when you were little? Why?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ buổi tối bạn làm gì? Tại sao?
qs.a6: When I was little, I did my homework and then played with my brother. We also watched cartoons on TV. There were no smartphones then.
qs.a7: As a kid, I'd finish my homework first, then play with my brother or watch cartoons on TV. We didn't have smartphones back then, so we entertained ourselves.
qs.grammar: *would + V* (thói quen quá khứ) → "I'**d finish** my homework first."

qs.q: Are there any differences between what you do in the evening now and in the past?
qs.vi: Buổi tối bây giờ khác gì so với trước?
qs.a6: Yes, a lot. Now I spend more time on my phone and studying, and less time playing. I also go to bed later.
qs.a7: Quite a lot. These days my evenings revolve around my phone and my study, whereas back then they were about playing and TV. I also stay up much later.
qs.grammar: *So sánh quá khứ – hiện tại* → "**These days**... whereas **back then**..."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ít sở thích nổi trội. Với Singing và Sports, bài mẫu theo hướng "hát cho vui, đá cầu lông/bóng đá hồi nhỏ, cổ vũ đội tuyển". Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật nhé. Câu trả lời "không thích/không làm" vẫn tốt, miễn là có lý do và ví dụ.

topics.title: Old Buildings

qs.q: Have you ever seen some old buildings in the city?
qs.vi: Bạn đã từng thấy các tòa nhà cổ trong thành phố chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, many. In Hanoi's Old Quarter and the French Quarter, there are old houses and churches. They look beautiful.
qs.a7: Plenty. Hanoi's Old Quarter and French Quarter are full of old tube houses and colonial buildings. They give the city its character.
qs.grammar: *be full of + N* → "full **of** old houses." (không "full with")

qs.q: Do you think we should keep old buildings in cities?
qs.vi: Chúng ta có nên giữ các tòa nhà cổ trong thành phố không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. They are part of our history and they attract tourists. If we knock them down, we lose a part of our culture.
qs.a7: Absolutely. They're a link to our past, and they draw tourists. Once they're knocked down, they're gone for good, so we should preserve them wherever possible.

vocab.m: mối liên kết với quá khứ

qs.grammar: *Bị động* → "they're **knocked down**."

qs.q: Do you prefer living in an old building or a modern house?
qs.vi: Bạn thích sống trong nhà cổ hay nhà hiện đại?
qs.a6: I prefer a modern house. It's more comfortable and has new facilities. Old houses are beautiful, but they can be damp and hard to repair.
qs.a7: A modern one, I'm afraid. Old buildings have charm, but they can be damp and costly to maintain, whereas a modern place comes with proper facilities and better security.
qs.grammar: *whereas* đối lập → "Old buildings..., **whereas** a modern place..."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ít sở thích nổi trội. Với Singing và Sports, bài mẫu theo hướng "hát cho vui, đá cầu lông/bóng đá hồi nhỏ, cổ vũ đội tuyển". Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật nhé. Câu trả lời "không thích/không làm" vẫn tốt, miễn là có lý do và ví dụ.

topics.title: Sports

qs.q: Did you do any sport when you were younger? (Why/Why not?)
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn có chơi môn thể thao nào không?
qs.a6: Yes, I played badminton and football with friends after school. I enjoyed them because they were fun and healthy.
qs.a7: Yes, I played football and badminton with friends after school. It was a great way to burn off energy and spend time together.
qs.grammar: *Quá khứ đơn* → "I **played**..., It **was**..."

qs.q: Have you ever supported a sports team? (Why/Why not?)
qs.vi: Bạn đã từng cổ vũ đội thể thao nào chưa?
qs.a6: Yes, I support the Vietnamese national football team. I watch their matches with friends, and it's exciting when they win.
qs.a7: Yes, the Vietnamese national football team. Watching their matches with friends is a real thrill, especially during big tournaments.
qs.grammar: *V-ing làm chủ ngữ* → "**Watching** their matches is a real thrill."

qs.q: Do you enjoy watching sports? (Why/Why not?)
qs.vi: Bạn có thích xem thể thao không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do, especially football. It's exciting, and I like to watch it with my friends.
qs.a7: Yes, especially football. The atmosphere is electric, and it's a great excuse to catch up with friends.
qs.grammar: *especially + N* → "especially football."

qs.q: Do you think there is too much sport on television in your country? (Why/Why not?)
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ truyền hình nước bạn có quá nhiều thể thao không?
qs.a6: I don't think so. There are some sports channels, but I can choose what I watch. Football is popular, so TV shows it a lot.
qs.a7: Not really. Sport takes up a reasonable share of airtime, mostly football, which reflects its popularity. And if you're not interested, you can simply switch channels.
qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 1* → "**If** you're not interested, you can switch channels."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ít sở thích nổi trội. Với Singing và Sports, bài mẫu theo hướng "hát cho vui, đá cầu lông/bóng đá hồi nhỏ, cổ vũ đội tuyển". Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật nhé. Câu trả lời "không thích/không làm" vẫn tốt, miễn là có lý do và ví dụ.

topics.title: Science

qs.q: Do you like science?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích khoa học không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. I like learning how things work, and science is useful in daily life.
qs.a7: Yes, I do. I'm curious about how things work, and as someone in IT, I appreciate how science and technology go hand in hand.

vocab.m: với tư cách người làm IT

qs.grammar: *"how things work"* → câu hỏi gián tiếp, **không đảo**: ✗ how do things work.

qs.q: What science have you studied?
qs.vi: Bạn đã học những môn khoa học nào?
qs.a6: I studied physics, chemistry and biology at school. At university I also studied computer science.
qs.a7: At school, the usual trio: physics, chemistry and biology. Later, at university, I moved on to computer science, which is closer to what I do now.
qs.grammar: *so sánh "closer to"* → "closer to what I do now."

qs.q: How do you study science?
qs.vi: Bạn học khoa học như thế nào?
qs.a6: I learn from textbooks and do experiments. Now I also watch videos on YouTube to understand better.
qs.a7: Back at school, it was mostly textbooks and lab experiments. Nowadays, I find short explainer videos on YouTube a much easier way to grasp new ideas.
qs.grammar: *find + O + N* → "I find videos **a much easier way**."

qs.q: What's the most difficult part of studying science?
qs.vi: Phần khó nhất khi học khoa học là gì?
qs.a6: For me, it's the math and the formulas. I often forget them, and I have to practise a lot.
qs.a7: The formulas, without a doubt. They're easy to forget, and it takes a lot of practice to apply them to real problems.
qs.grammar: *It takes + N + to + V* → "It takes **a lot of practice to apply** them."

qs.q: How has the science you studied helped you?
qs.vi: Khoa học bạn đã học giúp ích gì cho bạn?
qs.a6: It helps me think logically. In my job, I need to find the cause of a bug, so logical thinking is very useful.
qs.a7: It's trained me to think logically and approach problems step by step, which is exactly what I need when I'm tracking down the root cause of a bug.
qs.grammar: *Present perfect* → "It**'s trained** me to think logically." (kết quả ở hiện tại)

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, chăm sóc da buổi sáng. "Học Computer Science ở đại học", "tính hơi trầm" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Comedy / Jokes

qs.q: Do you like watching movies that make you laugh?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích xem phim hài không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. After a stressful day at work, I want to watch something light and funny.
qs.a7: Yes, definitely. After a stressful day at work, I'm after something light-hearted that takes my mind off things.
qs.grammar: *something + adj + that...* → "something light-hearted **that** takes my mind off things."

qs.q: Do you find it easy to make others laugh?
qs.vi: Bạn có dễ làm người khác cười không?
qs.a6: Not really. I'm a quiet person and I'm not good at telling jokes. But I can make my close friends laugh sometimes.
qs.a7: Not really. I'm on the quiet side, and my jokes tend to fall flat. Around close friends, though, I can be quite funny.
qs.grammar: *"though" giữa câu* → "Around close friends, **though**, I can be funny."

qs.q: Do you think it's a good thing if you always make others laugh?
qs.vi: Luôn làm người khác cười có phải điều tốt không?
qs.a6: Not always. Making people laugh is good, but if you joke all the time, people might not take you seriously.
qs.a7: Up to a point. Laughter lightens the mood, but if you're constantly joking around, people may not take you seriously, especially at work.
qs.grammar: *might / may + V* (khả năng) → "people **may not take** you seriously."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, chăm sóc da buổi sáng. "Học Computer Science ở đại học", "tính hơi trầm" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: History

qs.q: Do you like learning history?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích học lịch sử không?
qs.a6: Not really. At school, I had to remember many dates and names, and it was boring. But now I find it more interesting.
qs.a7: It wasn't my favourite at school, because it was all dates and names to memorise. These days, though, I find it much more interesting, particularly when it's told as a story.

vocab.m: được kể như một câu chuyện

qs.grammar: *when + bị động* → "when it's told as a story."

qs.q: What historical event do you find most interesting?
qs.vi: Sự kiện lịch sử nào bạn thấy thú vị nhất?
qs.a6: I think the Dien Bien Phu campaign in 1954 is interesting. It was an important victory for Vietnam, and it helped end the French colonial rule.
qs.a7: I'd say the Dien Bien Phu campaign in 1954. It was a turning point for Vietnam, as it helped bring an end to French colonial rule.
qs.grammar: *help + V* → "it **helped bring** an end." (sau help có thể bỏ "to")

qs.q: Do you think history is important?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ lịch sử quan trọng không?
qs.a6: Yes, it's important. We learn from past mistakes, and we understand our culture and identity.
qs.a7: Definitely. It helps us learn from past mistakes and gives us a sense of identity. Without it, we'd keep repeating the same errors.
qs.grammar: *Without + N, S + would + V* → "Without it, we'**d keep** repeating the same errors."

qs.q: Do you like to watch programmes on TV about history?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích xem chương trình lịch sử trên TV không?
qs.a6: Sometimes. I prefer documentaries, because they use old pictures and videos. They make history more real.
qs.a7: Occasionally. I prefer documentaries, since the archive footage and reconstructions bring history to life.
qs.grammar: *since + lý do* → "since the footage brings history to life."

qs.q: Do you think the internet is a good place to learn about history?
qs.vi: Internet có phải nơi tốt để học lịch sử không?
qs.a6: Yes, but you need to be careful. There's a lot of information and videos, but some of it is not correct.
qs.a7: To an extent. It's quick and there's plenty of free material, but you have to be careful, as not everything online is accurate. I'd double-check anything important.
qs.grammar: *not everything + V(số ít)* → "**not everything online is** accurate."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, chăm sóc da buổi sáng. "Học Computer Science ở đại học", "tính hơi trầm" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Morning Routine

qs.q: Do you like to get up early in the morning?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích dậy sớm không?
qs.a6: Not really. I'm not a morning person, but I have to get up early to catch the bus to work.
qs.a7: Honestly, no. I'm not a morning person, but I have to be up early to catch the bus, so I don't have much choice.
qs.grammar: *have to + V* → "I **have to be** up early."

qs.q: What do you do in the morning? What is your morning routine?
qs.vi: Buổi sáng bạn làm gì? Thói quen buổi sáng của bạn?
qs.a6: I wake up at six, wash my face and do my skincare. Then I have breakfast and go to the bus stop at seven.
qs.a7: I'm up at around six. First comes my skincare routine, then a quick breakfast, and I'm out of the door by seven to catch the bus.
qs.grammar: *Trình tự* → "First..., then..., and..." hoặc *After that, ...*

qs.q: Is breakfast important?
qs.vi: Bữa sáng có quan trọng không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. It gives me energy for the morning. If I skip it, I feel hungry and can't focus.
qs.a7: Yes, definitely. It gives me the energy to get through the morning. If I skip it, I'm starving by ten and can't concentrate.
qs.grammar: *Câu điều kiện loại 1* → "**If** I skip it, I'm starving."

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, đi xe buýt, chăm sóc da buổi sáng. "Học Computer Science ở đại học", "tính hơi trầm" là giả định. Bạn thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Study / Subject

qs.q: Describe your education.
qs.vi: Hãy mô tả quá trình học tập của bạn.
qs.a6: I went to a state primary school and secondary school in my area, and then I studied Information Technology at a university in Hanoi. I graduated a few years ago.
qs.a7: I went through the state school system in my area, then went on to study Information Technology at a university in Hanoi. I graduated a few years ago and have worked as a tester ever since.
qs.grammar: *Quá khứ đơn + present perfect* → "I graduated a few years ago and **have worked** as a tester ever since."

qs.q: What is your area of specialisation?
qs.vi: Chuyên ngành của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: I specialised in software engineering. I learned programming and how to test software.
qs.a7: My major was software engineering, so I covered programming, databases and software testing, which led me into my current career.
qs.grammar: *"which" cho cả mệnh đề* → "..., **which** led me into my current career."

qs.q: Why did you choose to study that major?
qs.vi: Tại sao bạn chọn học ngành đó?
qs.a6: I chose it because I like computers and IT jobs have good salaries. My family also supported me.
qs.a7: Two reasons. I've always been comfortable with computers, and IT offers good career prospects and a decent salary. My family also encouraged me.
qs.grammar: *Mở đầu rõ ràng* → "Two reasons." / "For two main reasons." Giúp bài nói mạch lạc (Coherence).

qs.q: What kind of school did you go to as a child?
qs.vi: Hồi nhỏ bạn học trường như thế nào?
qs.a6: I went to a normal state school near my house. The classes were big, but the teachers were kind.
qs.a7: An ordinary state school close to home. The classes were large, but the teachers were caring and the atmosphere was friendly.
qs.grammar: *Rút gọn câu trả lời* → "An ordinary state school close to home." (trả lời trực tiếp bằng cụm danh từ rất tự nhiên)

qs.q: What was your favourite subject as a child?
qs.vi: Môn học yêu thích hồi nhỏ của bạn là gì?
qs.a6: My favourite subject was Maths because I liked solving problems. I also liked English a little.
qs.a7: Maths, hands down. I enjoyed the feeling of cracking a tricky problem, which probably explains why I ended up in IT.
qs.grammar: *"which probably explains why..."* → mệnh đề kết nối nguyên nhân – kết quả.

qs.q: Do you think your country has an effective education system?
qs.vi: Hệ thống giáo dục nước bạn có hiệu quả không?
qs.a6: Not completely. Students study hard, but there's too much theory and too many exams. We need more practical skills.
qs.a7: Partly. Students learn a lot, but the system leans too heavily on exams and memorising, with too little emphasis on practical and soft skills. It's improving, though.
qs.grammar: *too much / too many* → *too much theory* (không đếm được), *too many exams* (đếm được).

qs.q: (Possibly) Are you looking forward to working?
qs.vi: Bạn có mong chờ đi làm không?
qs.a6: I'm already working, so yes and no. I enjoy my job and learning new things, but I also want more free time.
qs.a7: I've already started, and on the whole I'm enjoying it. There's always something new to learn, although I do look forward to the weekends!

vocab.u: **to** là giới từ: *look forward to working*

qs.grammar: *look forward to + V-ing / N* → "I look forward to **the weekends**." (✗ look forward to work → *to working*)

topics.note: Thông tin giả định: IT Tester/QC ở Hà Nội, ngoại thành, đi xe buýt. Mình giả định: học ngành Công nghệ thông tin ở Hà Nội, sống nhà 3 tầng cùng bố mẹ và em trai, quê là một vùng ngoại thành có làng nghề truyền thống. Mục Hometown và Home có nhiều chi tiết giả định nhất. Bạn nhớ thay bằng thông tin thật.

topics.title: Home / Accommodation

qs.q: What kind of housing do you live in?
qs.vi: Bạn sống ở loại nhà ở nào?
qs.a6: I live in a house in the suburbs of Hanoi. It has three floors, and it's not very big.
qs.a7: I live in a three-storey house in the suburbs of Hanoi. It's not huge, but it's cosy and practical for a family.

vocab.u: **storey** số ít trong tính từ ghép

qs.grammar: *Tính từ ghép* → "a **three-storey** house." (✗ three-stories)

qs.q: Who do you live with?
qs.vi: Bạn sống cùng ai?
qs.a6: I live with my parents and my brother. We're a close family, and my mother cooks for us.
qs.a7: I live with my parents and my younger brother. We're a close-knit family, and it's nice to come home to a home-cooked meal.
qs.grammar: *It's nice to + V* → "It's nice **to come** home to a meal."

qs.q: How long have you lived there?
qs.vi: Bạn đã sống ở đó bao lâu?
qs.a6: About ten years. Before that, we rented a smaller place closer to the city centre.
qs.a7: About ten years now. Before that, we rented a smaller place closer to the centre, so moving here felt like a big upgrade.
qs.grammar: *Present perfect* → "I**'ve lived** here for about ten years." (dùng for + khoảng thời gian)

qs.q: What's the difference between where you are living now and where you have lived in the past?
qs.vi: Nơi bạn sống bây giờ khác gì so với nơi bạn từng sống?
qs.a6: Before, we lived in a smaller rented house near the city. Now my house is bigger and more modern, but it's farther from the city centre.
qs.a7: We used to rent a small, old place nearer the city. The current house is much more spacious and modern, but the commute into town is a lot longer.
qs.grammar: *so sánh hơn + "much / a lot"* → "much more spacious", "a lot longer."

qs.q: Do you plan to live there for a long time?
qs.vi: Bạn có định sống ở đó lâu dài không?
qs.a6: Yes, I think so. It's my family's house, and I'm comfortable there. Maybe I'll move closer to the city when I have my own family.
qs.a7: For the time being, yes. It's my family home and I'm comfortable there, but I might move closer to the city centre when I start a family of my own.
qs.grammar: *might + V* (khả năng) → "I **might move** closer."

qs.q: Which room does your family spend most of the time in?
qs.vi: Gia đình bạn dành nhiều thời gian nhất ở phòng nào?
qs.a6: The living room. We have dinner there and watch TV together in the evening.
qs.a7: The living room, no doubt. It's where we eat, watch TV and just chat in the evening.
qs.grammar: *"It's where + mệnh đề"* → "It's **where** we eat and watch TV."

qs.q: Are the transport facilities to your home very good?
qs.vi: Giao thông đến nhà bạn có tốt không?
qs.a6: Not very good. There is a bus stop nearby, but buses are not frequent, and I need about an hour to get to the centre.
qs.a7: Not great, to be honest. There's a bus stop a short walk away, but the buses aren't very frequent, and it takes me about an hour to reach the city centre.

vocab.m: cách một quãng đi bộ ngắn

vocab.p: it takes me + thời gian + to V

qs.grammar: *It takes me + time + to + V* → "It takes me an hour **to reach** the centre."

qs.q: Do you prefer living in a house or a flat?
qs.vi: Bạn thích sống ở nhà riêng hay chung cư?
qs.a6: I prefer a house because it has more space and it's quieter. But a flat is more convenient in the city centre.
qs.a7: A house, I think. It gives you more space and privacy. A flat has its advantages, like security and being closer to the centre, but I prefer having room to breathe.
qs.grammar: *like + N* (ví dụ) → "advantages, **like** security."

qs.q: What part of your home do you like the most?
qs.vi: Bạn thích nhất khu vực nào trong nhà?
qs.a6: I like my bedroom the most. It's quiet, and I can relax, study and sleep there.
qs.a7: My bedroom. It's my own little corner of the world, where I can study, unwind and recharge in peace.

vocab.p: a little corner of the world

qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ "where"* → "my bedroom, **where** I can study."

topics.title: Hometown

qs.q: Do you like living there?
qs.vi: Bạn có thích sống ở đó không?
qs.a6: Yes, I do. It's peaceful, the air is cleaner, and the people are friendly.
qs.a7: Yes, very much. It's peaceful, the air is fresher than in the centre, and everyone knows each other.
qs.grammar: *So sánh hơn* → "fresh**er** than in the centre."

qs.q: Do you think you will continue living there for a long time?
qs.vi: Bạn có nghĩ mình sẽ sống ở đó lâu dài không?
qs.a6: Probably not forever. I might move closer to the city for work, but I will always visit my family there.
qs.a7: Probably not forever. I might need to move closer to the centre for work, but I'll always keep going back to visit.
qs.grammar: *might need to + V* → "I **might need to move**."

qs.q: Please describe your hometown a little.
qs.vi: Hãy mô tả sơ qua quê hương của bạn.
qs.a6: My hometown is a quiet area on the outskirts of Hanoi. There are rice fields, small markets and a few old villages. Life there is slow and relaxed.
qs.a7: It's a quiet area on the outskirts of Hanoi, with rice fields, small markets and a few traditional villages. Life moves at a slower pace than in the city, which I find really relaxing.
qs.grammar: *Mệnh đề quan hệ "which"* → "..., **which** I find really relaxing."

qs.q: What's your hometown famous for?
qs.vi: Quê bạn nổi tiếng về điều gì?
qs.a6: It's famous for its traditional craft villages. Tourists come to see how handmade products are made.
qs.a7: It's best known for its traditional craft villages, where visitors can watch artisans making handmade products the old-fashioned way.
qs.grammar: *"where" + V-ing* → "villages, where visitors can watch artisans **making**..."

qs.q: Did you learn about the history of your hometown at school?
qs.vi: Bạn có học về lịch sử quê hương ở trường không?
qs.a6: A little. We learned some local history in class, and sometimes the school organised trips to local historical places.
qs.a7: A little. We had a few lessons on local history, and the school took us on field trips to nearby temples and relics.
qs.grammar: *take + O + on + N* → "took us **on** field trips."

qs.q: Are there many young people in your hometown?
qs.vi: Quê bạn có nhiều người trẻ không?
qs.a6: Not many. Many young people move to the city to study and work, so the area has more older people and children.
qs.a7: Not really. A lot of young people head off to the city for university and jobs, so you mostly see older people and children.
qs.grammar: *"you" nói chung* → "you mostly see..." (dùng *you* để nói về người nói chung)

qs.q: Is your hometown a good place for young people to pursue their careers?
qs.vi: Quê bạn có phải nơi tốt để người trẻ theo đuổi sự nghiệp không?
qs.a6: No, not really. There aren't many job opportunities, especially in IT. Young people have to go to the city.
qs.a7: Not really. Job opportunities are limited, especially in fields like IT, so ambitious young people have little choice but to move to the city.

vocab.p: have little choice but to + V

qs.grammar: *have little choice but to + V* → "have little choice **but to move**."

topics.title: Neighbourhood / Area

qs.q: Do you know your neighbours?
qs.vi: Bạn có quen hàng xóm không?
qs.a6: Yes, I know most of them. We've lived here for a long time, so we say hello to each other.
qs.a7: Yes, most of them, since we've lived in the area for years. We always greet each other and sometimes chat over the fence.
qs.grammar: *since + lý do* → "since we've lived in the area for years."

qs.q: What do you think of your neighbours?
qs.vi: Bạn nghĩ gì về hàng xóm của mình?
qs.a6: They're kind and helpful. When my family has a big event, they come to help.
qs.a7: They're warm and helpful. Whenever my family has a big event, they're the first to offer a hand.
qs.grammar: *whenever + mệnh đề* → "**Whenever** my family has a big event, ..."

qs.q: How do you get along well with your neighbours?
qs.vi: Làm thế nào bạn hòa thuận với hàng xóm?
qs.a6: I greet them, I'm polite, and I help when they need it. We also share food at Tet.
qs.a7: By staying polite, keeping the noise down, and helping out when they need it. We also swap food and small gifts around Tet, which keeps relations warm.
qs.grammar: *By + V-ing* → "**By staying** polite, **keeping** the noise down, and **helping** out." (3 V-ing song song)
